NVDA.title: NVIDIA and IREN Announce Strategic Partnership to Deploy up to 5 Gigawatts of AI Infrastructure
NVDA.content: NVIDIA and IREN intend to deploy next-generation AI infrastructure across IREN's global data center pipeline. IREN issued NVIDIA a 5-year right to purchase up to 30M shares at $70/share ($2.1B potential equity investment).

NVDA.title: NVIDIA and Corning Announce Multiyear Partnership to Expand U.S. Optical Manufacturing 10x for AI Infrastructure
NVDA.content: Corning to increase U.S. optical connectivity manufacturing capacity by 10x and U.S. fiber production by 50%+, building 3 new facilities in North Carolina and Texas, creating 3,000+ jobs.

NVDA.title: NVIDIA Q1 FY2027 Earnings Preview: Analysts Expect $78.8B Revenue on May 20
NVDA.content: Wall Street expects $78.8B revenue and $1.77 EPS for Q1 FY2027 (ends April 2026). Stock up ~15% YTD but underperforming Intel and AMD. Earnings scheduled May 20.

NVDA.title: Congress Advances AI OVERWATCH Act to Restrict Blackwell Chip Sales to China, Iran, Russia for 2 Years
NVDA.content: House Foreign Affairs Committee advanced the AI OVERWATCH Act, treating NVDA Blackwell chip exports like weapons sales; would prohibit sales to entities of concern (China, Iran, NK, Russia, Venezuela) for 2 years. Direct regulatory risk for NVDA.

NVDA.title: NVIDIA Ships First Vera Rubin Samples; DeepSeek Blackwell Violation Heightens Export Scrutiny Ahead of May 20 Earnings
NVDA.content: NVIDIA shipped first Vera Rubin architecture samples to customers this week — successor to Blackwell delivering up to 10x lower inference token cost and 4x fewer GPUs needed to train MoE models. Separately, Reuters reported DeepSeek trained its latest model on Blackwell chips in apparent export control violation, intensifying Washington regulatory scrutiny ahead of NVDA's May 20 Q1 FY2027 earnings ($78.8B revenue guide).

NVDA.title: Nvidia H200 Chip Shipments Resume to China; ByteDance, Alibaba, Tencent Clear 400,000+ Units
NVDA.content: Nvidia is preparing to ship 82,000 H200 AI GPUs to China under revised US export controls allowing H200 sales on a case-by-case basis at 25% tariff. China approved imports for ByteDance, Alibaba, and Tencent totaling 400,000+ units — a major demand reopening ahead of May 20 earnings.

NVDA.title: Jensen Huang Not Invited on Trump China Delegation — AI Chip Export Easing to China Unlikely Near-Term
NVDA.content: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was excluded from Trump's May 13-15 China state visit delegation (Tim Cook and Elon Musk included). Huang said he would join if invited but received no invitation. Analysts: Huang's absence signals AI semiconductor exports to China remain a sensitive category unlikely to recover soon; White House focused on agriculture and commercial aviation, not advanced AI chips. NVDA Q1 FY2027 earnings May 20, $78.8B revenue consensus.

NVDA.title: NVIDIA Stock Hits All-Time High $227.84; Market Cap Reaches $5.4 Trillion Ahead of May 20 Earnings
NVDA.content: NVDA hit intraday ATH $227.84 on May 13, pushing market cap to $5.4 trillion. 37 analysts rate Strong Buy with $272 consensus target. Earnings scheduled May 20; consensus calls for $78.8B revenue and $1.77 EPS. China H200 stalled; Jensen Huang excluded from Trump China delegation.

NVDA.title: Trump-Xi Summit May 14-15: H200 AI Chip Sales Cleared to ~10 Chinese Firms; US-China Tariffs Cut 145%→30%
NVDA.content: US-China trade truce (May 12) cut US tariffs 145%→30%, China tariffs 125%→10%. At Trump-Xi summit May 14-15, Washington cleared H200 GPU sales to ~10 Chinese firms (Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance). Blackwell controls NOT lifted. Semiconductor export controls, rare earth restrictions, and antitrust probes vs Nvidia/Qualcomm/Intel remain on negotiating table.

NVDA.title: Nvidia Earnings Preview May 20: Analysts Expect $79.2B Revenue; 97% Beat Probability Priced In
NVDA.content: Q1 FY2027 earnings due after market close May 20; analysts project $79.2B revenue (+86% YoY), $1.78 adjusted EPS. Top hyperscalers raised AI capex guidance to $725B combined. H200 China sales approved for ~10 firms.

NVDA.title: US Government Approves Nvidia H200 Chip Exports to China; ~10 Firms Cleared, 75,000-Unit Cap Per Customer
NVDA.content: Commerce Department cleared ~10 Chinese firms including Alibaba, Tencent and ByteDance to purchase H200 chips, capped at 75,000 units each. China shipments must not exceed half of domestic US sales.

NVDA.title: NVIDIA Q1 FY2027 Record Earnings: Revenue $81.6B (+85% YoY), Data Center $75.2B (+92%); Q2 Guidance ~$91B; $80B Buyback Added
NVDA.content: Q1 FY2027 (ended April 2026): Revenue $81.6B beat $78.8B est (+85% YoY); Data Center $75.2B (+92% YoY). GAAP EPS $2.39 beat $1.75 est; GAAP GM 74.9%. Q2 guidance ~$91B ±2%, mid-70% GM, no assumed China DC compute revenue. $80B buyback authorization added; dividend raised to $0.25/share.

NVDA.title: NVIDIA Stock Falls 0.9% Day After Record Q1 FY2027 Earnings; Fourth Consecutive Post-Earnings Slide
NVDA.content: Despite record Q1 FY2027 results ($81.6B revenue, $2.39 EPS, Q2 guide $91B), NVDA stock declined 0.9% on May 21 — fourth consecutive post-earnings decline. Analysts called it a "garden variety beat"; market had priced in perfection. Q2 guidance excludes China data center compute revenue.

AVGO.title: Wall Street Shifts AI Chip Focus Away from Nvidia and Broadcom Toward Intel, AMD, Micron
AVGO.content: Investors rotating from premium-priced NVDA/AVGO toward cheaper AI chip plays. Broadcom AI semiconductor revenue hit $8.4B last quarter (+106% YoY), guiding $10.7B next quarter; CEO targets $100B AI sales by 2027.

AVGO.title: Bernstein: AI Agent Demand Drives Chip Demand 'Off the Charts'; Broadcom Custom ASIC Among Key Beneficiaries
AVGO.content: Bernstein analyst notes AI agent proliferation driving chip demand 'off the charts.' Broadcom's hyperscaler ASIC business (Google TPU, Meta MTIA) and network switching chips are structural beneficiaries as supply struggles to keep up.

AVGO.title: Broadcom Q2 FY2026 Preview: $22B Revenue Guidance (+47% YoY), AI Semiconductor Revenue to Reach $10.7B (+140%); Earnings June 3
AVGO.content: Broadcom Q2 FY2026 earnings scheduled June 3, 2026. Q2 revenue guided at $22B (+47% YoY), AI semiconductor revenue expected $10.7B (+140% YoY). CEO Hock Tan targets $100B AI chip revenue by 2027. AI revenue backlog $73B. AVGO shares up 115% YoY and 23% YTD as hyperscaler ASIC (Google TPU, Meta MTIA) and network chip demand accelerates.

AVGO.title: Broadcom CEO Hock Tan Reiterates $100B AI Chip Target for 2027; Custom ASIC Demand 'Unprecedented'
AVGO.content: Broadcom CEO Hock Tan reiterated the $100B AI chip revenue target for 2027, citing 'unprecedented' demand for custom ASIC solutions. Google TPU, Meta MTIA, and a third hyperscaler ASIC program in development. Q2 FY2026 AI semiconductor revenue guided $10.7B (+140% YoY); June 3 earnings confirmed. AVGO backlog $73B with 18-month visibility.

AVGO.title: Wells Fargo Raises Broadcom Price Target to $545 from $430; AI Semiconductor Revenue Running 30-40% Above Prior Estimates
AVGO.content: Wells Fargo raised AVGO price target to $545 from $430, citing AI semiconductor revenue tracking 30-40% above prior estimates. Wolfe Research and Citi also raised targets to $500. AVGO rose 4.3% to new 52-week high $438. Year-to-date gain 26.1%.

AVGO.title: Broadcom Discloses Meta Partnership to Co-Develop 2nm Custom AI Chip; Citi Forecasts AI Revenue to Hit 81% of Sales by FY2028
AVGO.content: Broadcom disclosed partnership with Meta Platforms to co-develop a 2nm custom AI ASIC, expanding its hyperscaler ASIC client base beyond Google TPU. Citi forecasts Broadcom AI revenue growing from ~49% of total sales currently to ~81% by fiscal Q4 2028. Adds to existing Google TPU and Meta MTIA relationships.

AVGO.title: Analyst Raises Broadcom Target to $500; AI Revenue Doubled YoY to $8.4B; CEO Projects $100B AI Revenue in 2027
AVGO.content: Major bank raised AVGO target to $500 (from $475), Buy rating. AVGO Q1 FY2026: AI revenue $8.4B (+106% YoY), OpenAI joined named custom-silicon customers. CEO Hock Tan: 'line of sight to $100B AI chip revenue in 2027.' Stock up 30% YTD after -15% early 2026 dip.

AVGO.title: Evercore ISI Raises Broadcom Price Target to $582 from $490; Maintains Outperform — AI Demand Tracking Ahead of Estimates
AVGO.content: Evercore ISI analyst Mark Lipacis raised AVGO target to $582 (from $490), maintaining Outperform. AI semiconductor revenue tracking above consensus ahead of June 3 Q2 FY2026 earnings (guided $22B revenue, $10.7B AI chip). CEO Hock Tan $100B AI chip 2027 target viewed as increasingly achievable.

AVGO.title: London Stock Exchange Group Signs 5-Year Technology Partnership with Broadcom; AVGO Stock at $414
AVGO.content: LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) signed a new 5-year technology partnership agreement with Broadcom, expanding their existing relationship. AVGO stock closed at $414.57 on May 21 (-0.76%). Q2 FY2026 earnings June 3 with $22B revenue and $10.7B AI chip revenue guided. Goldman Sachs Buy reiterated May 20.

AMD.title: AMD Q1 2026 Earnings: Revenue $10.3B (+38% YoY), Data Center $5.8B (+57%); Q2 Guide $11.2B
AMD.content: AMD Q1 2026: total revenue $10.3B (+38% YoY), Data Center $5.8B (+57% YoY) on Instinct GPU and EPYC CPU momentum. Non-GAAP EPS $1.37. Q2 guidance $11.2B ±$300M (~46% YoY growth). Strong inference deployment ramp across cloud and enterprise.

AMD.title: Meta to Deploy up to 6 Gigawatts of AMD Instinct GPUs Including Custom MI450-Based Accelerators
AMD.content: Meta announced plans to deploy up to 6GW of AMD Instinct GPUs; first 1GW deployment utilizes a custom MI450-based GPU developed in partnership with AMD. Largest single AMD Instinct customer commitment announced.

AMD.title: Goldman Sachs and Bernstein Upgrade AMD to Buy After Blockbuster Q1 and Strong Q2 Guidance
AMD.content: Goldman Sachs and Bernstein upgraded AMD to Buy citing AI GPU demand acceleration and EPYC server CPU share gains from Intel. AMD shares surged 14%+ post-earnings as Wall Street diversifies AI chip exposure.

AMD.title: AMD Launches Instinct MI350P PCIe: 144GB HBM3E, CDNA4 Architecture for Enterprise On-Prem AI on Existing Servers
AMD.content: AMD launched Instinct MI350P, its first PCIe-based Instinct accelerator in 4 years: dual-slot air-cooled form factor, 144GB HBM3E at 4TB/s, peak 4,600 TFLOPS at MXFP4, 600W TBP. Enables enterprise AI deployment on existing air-cooled servers without major infrastructure upgrades. Dell expanded on-prem AI platform with MI350P support. CDNA4 architecture targets agentic AI inference workloads.

AMD.title: AMD Up 320% Over 12 Months: 33 Analysts Buy Consensus, $383 Median Target; MI450 Demand Exceeding Expectations
AMD.content: Following AMD Q1 2026 blowout results, 33 analysts maintain Buy consensus with median price target $383.45. CEO Lisa Su confirmed MI450 customer demand is exceeding initial expectations; AMD guided Q2 revenue ~$11.2B (+46% YoY).

AMD.title: AMD Approaches $1 Trillion Market Cap ($731B) After Blowout Q1; Data Center Revenue +57% YoY; Q2 Guide $11.2B
AMD.content: AMD Q1 2026 (reported May 5): revenue $10.25B (+38% YoY, beat $9.89B est), data center segment $5.8B (+57% YoY), non-GAAP EPS $1.37 beat $1.29 est. Q2 guide $11.2B (+46% YoY), non-GAAP GM ~56%. Market cap reached $731B on May 14, analysts speculate $1T milestone achievable in 2026.

AMD.title: AMD Commits $10B+ to Taiwan Ecosystem; Helios Rack-Scale Platform with MI450X GPUs Deploys H2 2026
AMD.content: AMD announced $10B+ in Taiwan ecosystem investments to expand advanced packaging partnerships for next-gen AI infrastructure. Helios rack-scale platform (MI450X GPU + 6th Gen EPYC CPU) to deploy H2 2026 with ODM partners Sanmina, Wiwynn, Wistron, and Inventec. AMD Ryzen PRO 9000 lineup also expanded May 20.

INTC.title: 美国政府持有 Intel 9.9% 非投票权股权 — CHIPS Act 拨款转股权
INTC.content: 美国政府将 Intel 剩余 CHIPS Act 拨款转为 9.9% 非投票权股权, 433M 股, 标志着政府成为唯一一家美国先进制程公司的实质股东。

INTC.title: Intel 18A (1.8nm) Fab 52 亚利桑那量产 — 美国本土首次先进节点 HVM
INTC.content: Intel Fab 52 (亚利桑那 Ocotillo) 18A 工艺进入 HVM, 首次美国本土实现先进制程量产, 战略意义对冲 TSMC 集中风险。

INTC.title: Intel 收到 $5.7B 加速 CHIPS Act 拨款
INTC.content: 经修订的 CHIPS Act 协议加速 $5.7B 拨款。Intel 仍独立运营 Foundry, 政府不参与运营决策。

INTC.title: NVDA-Intel 战略合作 — 老对手联手
INTC.content: Nvidia 和 Intel 达成战略合作, AI 生态新格局。

INTC.title: Intel Q1 2026 Blowout: Revenue $13.58B vs $12.42B Estimate; DCAI +22% to $5.1B; Stock +20% After-Hours
INTC.content: Intel Q1 2026: revenue $13.58B (vs $12.42B est), adj EPS $0.29 (vs $0.01 est). Data Center & AI (DCAI) +22% to $5.1B. Q2 guide $13.8-14.8B vs $13.07B est. Intel 18A-based Xeon 6 in full volume production — fastest new product ramp in 5 years. Sixth consecutive quarter beating expectations.

INTC.title: Wall Street Sees 'Changing of the Guard in AI' as Intel Doubles YTD While Nvidia Lags
INTC.content: Intel has more than doubled in value in 2026, leading AI chip sector. Xeon 6 CPU demand running ahead of supply. Investors rotating into INTC from NVDA on valuation and execution turnaround narrative.

INTC.title: Apple Confirms Intel 18A Foundry Agreement to Manufacture Entry-Level Mac/iPad Chips in U.S.; INTC Surges 14%
INTC.content: Bloomberg confirmed Apple entered foundry agreement with Intel to manufacture 18A-based chips for entry-level Mac and iPad product lines — a landmark validation of Intel Foundry Services as a competitive alternative to TSMC. INTC surged ~14% on the news. Validates CEO Lip-Bu Tan's pitch: Intel 18A is the most advanced process node manufactured in the U.S., with yields running ahead of internal projections.

INTC.title: Intel Computex 2026 Preview (June 2): Panther Lake Handhelds, 52-Core Nova Lake Desktop, 288-Core Clearwater Forest Server — All on 18A
INTC.content: Intel's Computex 2026 lineup (June 2 keynote, Taipei): Panther Lake Arc G3 gaming handhelds, Nova Lake 52-core desktop preview, and 288-core Clearwater Forest server — all built on Intel 18A. Entire lineup serves as foundry showcase to potential customers Apple, Amazon, and Musk's Terafab. CEO Tan keynote positions 18A as U.S.-made alternative to TSMC for advanced AI chip production.

INTC.title: Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan Confirmed as Computex 2026 Keynote on June 2 Taipei; Nova Lake, Panther Lake, Clearwater Forest to Preview
INTC.content: Intel confirmed CEO Lip-Bu Tan will keynote Computex 2026 on June 2 (1:30 PM Taiwan time), previewing Nova Lake (Core Ultra Series 4, up to 52 cores on 18A), Panther Lake Arc G3 handhelds, and AI data center platforms Crescent Island and Jaguar Shores — all built on Intel 18A.

INTC.title: Intel Stock Soars as Apple and Google Foundry Deals Validate 18A; INTC +116% Month-to-Date
INTC.content: Intel stock gained 4.65% on May 11, extending a 116% month-to-date surge, as reports confirmed both Apple foundry agreement and Google expanding partnership for EMIB advanced packaging on next-gen TPU chips. Google also committed to multiple generations of Intel CPUs for AI data center workloads. Dual hyperscaler customer wins — Apple (entry-level Mac/iPad chips) + Google (TPU EMIB + CPU) — cement Intel 18A Foundry Services as a commercial alternative to TSMC.

INTC.title: INTC Falls 5.21% on May 14: HSBC Downgrades; UBS Warns AMD at 27.4%, ARM at 17.7% Server CPU Share; Foundry Loss $2.3B
INTC.content: Intel stock fell 5.21% on May 14. HSBC downgraded Intel noting prior rally was based on one-off deals not sustainable fundamentals. UBS flagged server CPU market share erosion: Intel at 54.9% (down 370bps sequentially), AMD gained 230bps to 27.4%, ARM gained 140bps to 17.7%. Intel Foundry Q1 2026 operating loss $2.3B; 18A and 14A process yields below expectations.

INTC.title: Intel Stock Continues 200% YTD Rally on Apple + Google Foundry Deal Momentum; 18A Node Commercial Production
INTC.content: INTC +200% YTD as Apple 18A agreement and Google foundry discussions validate Intel's manufacturing revival. Elon Musk's Terafab ($119B Austin fab) to use 14A node. CHIPS Act: $8.5B grants + $11B loans secured.

INTC.title: Intel +6.71% on Melius Research Upgrade to $150: "CPU Renaissance" — Inference AI Proving More CPU-Intensive Than Expected
INTC.content: Intel surged 6.71% on May 20 after Melius Research raised target to $150. Thesis: agentic/inference AI workloads are proving far more CPU-intensive than pure GPU compute, triggering a "CPU renaissance." Intel asking PC partners to adopt more 18A CPUs. Server CPU share 54.9% (from 64.4% a year ago) but overall demand growing. Sixth consecutive beat-and-raise quarter.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm Q2 FY2026 Beats: Revenue $10.6B, EPS $2.65; Automotive First Time Exceeds $5B Annualized Rate
QCOM.content: QCOM Q2 FY2026: revenue $10.6B, EPS $2.65, both clearing consensus. Automotive segment first time exceeding $5B annualized revenue. Initial data center silicon shipments to a leading hyperscaler in December 2025. Stock rose ~15%.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm Shares Up 6% on New Snapdragon X2 PC Platform with 85 TOPS NPU; AI PC Race Heats Up
QCOM.content: Qualcomm launched Snapdragon X2 PC platform with 85 TOPS Hexagon NPU, outperforming Intel Pinter Lake by ~30%. Targets always-on agentic AI PC experiences. Data center silicon shipment to hyperscaler adds new growth vector.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm Authorizes $20B Share Buyback; Confirms First Data Center Processor Shipments to Hyperscaler in December 2025
QCOM.content: Alongside Q2 FY2026 earnings beat, Qualcomm authorized $20B share buyback program. CEO Cristiano Amon confirmed initial data center processor shipments already completed to a leading hyperscaler in December 2025, establishing data center as a new revenue vector. Automotive segment exceeded $5B annualized revenue for the first time. Stock surged 15% post-earnings.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm Hits All-Time High $247.90 (+9% on May 11); 42% 5-Day Rally on Data Center Entry + Tariff Relief; Leads Nasdaq 100
QCOM.content: QCOM surged 9% on May 11 to intraday all-time record $247.90, extending a 42% gain over 5 consecutive trading days. Catalysts: hyperscaler data center silicon shipments confirmed; 90-day US-China tariff suspension boosting smartphone demand; analyst upgrades (Daiwa Outperform $225, Tigress $280, Benchmark $225). QCOM led both S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 in performance on the day.

QCOM.title: QCOM Down 4.47% on May 14: BNP Paribas Downgrades to Neutral, Cuts Target $180→$120; UBS Trims to $150 on Handset Weakness
QCOM.content: Qualcomm fell 4.47% on May 14 as profit-taking met fresh downgrades. BNP Paribas cut to Neutral with target slashed from $180 to $120, citing anticipated low double-digit smartphone shipment declines in 2026, slow diversification, and lack of near-term growth catalysts. UBS trimmed target from $160 to $150 on deteriorating handset fundamentals.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm QCOM Executives Join Trump China Delegation; CEO Amon Highlights Work with Meta, OpenAI on AI Hardware
QCOM.content: Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon joined Trump's China delegation. Amon said QCOM is working with 'pretty much all' major AI players including Meta and OpenAI on top-secret hardware. QCOM fell 11% on May 12 amid broader semiconductor rotation on macro/Iran tension concerns.

MRVL.title: Marvell Crushed April 2026: Custom AI Silicon at $1.5B Run Rate, Projected to $9-11B in 2026; NVIDIA $2B Partnership
MRVL.content: Marvell custom silicon business reached $1.5B annual run rate in FY2026, scaling to $9-11B projected for 2026. $2B NVIDIA strategic investment validates technology. High-volume production commenced for two major hyperscale AI customers in early 2026.

MRVL.title: Marvell Stock Surges on Google AI Chip Deal and 50+ New Custom ASIC Design Engagements
MRVL.content: MRVL up 84%+ YTD driven by custom silicon ramp for Google TPU and other hyperscalers. Over 50 new custom AI chip design engagements across 10+ customers. Data center revenue 73% of total mix at $1.519B last quarter.

MRVL.title: Marvell Acquires Polariton Technologies to Advance AI Data Center Optical Connectivity to 3.2T and Beyond
MRVL.content: Marvell acquired Polariton Technologies, a developer of high-speed low-power plasmonics-based silicon photonics devices. Terms undisclosed. Adds advanced modulation enabling continued scaling from 1.6T toward 3.2T+ optical connectivity, strengthening Marvell's end-to-end portfolio across ASIC, switching, electro-optics, and photonics for next-generation AI data center architectures.

MRVL.title: Marvell Up 67% in April Alone: Alphabet ASIC Co-Development Confirmed, Nvidia $2B Investment, Custom Silicon at $1.5B Run Rate
MRVL.content: MRVL surged 67% in April 2026 on three catalysts: confirmed Alphabet co-development agreement for custom AI ASIC, $2B Nvidia strategic investment validating technology, and custom silicon reaching $1.5B annual run rate (projected $9-11B for calendar 2026). Over 50 new design engagements across 10+ customers; data center now 73% of revenue mix at $1.519B last quarter.

MRVL.title: Marvell FY2026 Full-Year Revenue $8.195B (+42% YoY); Raises FY2027 Outlook to ~$11B; Q4 FY2026 Earnings on May 21
MRVL.content: Marvell Technology reported full fiscal year 2026 revenue of $8.195B (+42% YoY). Data center surpassed $6B for the year (+46% YoY). Q4 FY2026 revenue $2.219B (+22% YoY). Company raised FY2027 revenue outlook to approach $11B (>30% YoY growth) and FY2028 to ~$15B (~40% YoY). Next earnings report: Q1 FY2027 scheduled May 21, 2026.

MRVL.title: Analysts Raise Marvell Price Targets Ahead of May 21 Q1 FY2027 Earnings; TD Cowen Doubles Target to $180
MRVL.content: Multiple analysts raised MRVL targets ahead of May 21 earnings. TD Cowen raised to $180 from $90. Company guided Q1 revenue of $2.4B (vs $2.28B consensus). AI ASIC (AWS Trainium) + optical interconnect business driving growth.

MRVL.title: Marvell Q1 FY2027 Beats Estimates; Citi Raises Target to $215 (+82%), RBC $200, Wolfe $210; Google TPU Memory Chips
MRVL.source: Marvell IR / Citi / RBC / Wolfe Research
MRVL.content: Marvell Q1 FY2027 earnings (May 21) beat consensus estimates. Analysts raised targets: Citi to $215 (from $118), RBC to $200, Wolfe Research to $210. Google collaboration on custom TPU memory chip designs confirmed. Shares had surged +50%+ over prior month. FY2027 revenue outlook ~$11B (>30% YoY), FY2028 ~$15B (~40% YoY). AI ASIC and optical interconnect businesses driving growth.

APP.title: AppLovin Q1 2026: Revenue $1.84B (+59% YoY), Net Income $1.21B (+109%); Q2 Guidance $1.93B at 84% EBITDA Margin
APP.content: APP Q1 2026: revenue $1.842B (+59%), net income $1.206B (+109%), adj EBITDA $1.557B (+66%), FCF $1.3B. Q2 guidance revenue $1.93B, EBITDA $1.63B (84% margin). Repurchased 2.2M shares for $1B. Morgan Stanley reiterates Overweight at $720.

APP.title: AppLovin Announces June Public Launch of Axon Platform; Consumer Vertical April Revenue at Record Highs
APP.content: AppLovin to publicly launch Axon advertising platform in June 2026, targeting expansion beyond mobile gaming. Consumer vertical March spend +25% vs January; April at record highs. Gaming ad revenue +44% YoY in Q2 guide.

APP.title: Morgan Stanley: AppLovin June Axon Self-Service Launch Is Key Catalyst; E-Commerce Advertiser Spend +50% Weekly
APP.content: Morgan Stanley identified June 2026 Axon self-service platform launch as the next pivotal catalyst for APP. E-commerce advertisers show 50% weekly spend growth on Axon; Axon 2.0 model improvements and durable margin expansion prospects highlighted. Reiterated Overweight rating post-Q1.

APP.title: AppLovin Stock Falls 7.65% on May 13 as Broader AI Software Rotation Continues; Record Q1 Beat Priced In
APP.content: AppLovin shares declined 7.65% on May 13 as broader AI software valuations faced pressure amid rising rates and macro concerns. APP reported record Q1 2026 revenue $1.842B (+59% YoY) and EPS $3.56, with Q2 guided $1.93B at 84% EBITDA margin. June 2026 Axon self-service platform launch remains the next key catalyst per Morgan Stanley (Overweight, $720 target).

TSM.title: US-Taiwan Trade Deal: TSMC Arizona Investment Expands to $465B; 11 Fabs Planned Under 15% Tariff Framework
TSM.content: US-Taiwan trade deal caps tariffs on Taiwanese goods at 15%. TSMC plans to expand Arizona investment from $165B to $465B, adding 5 more fabs for 11 total. N2 and A16 processes included. Second fab P2 equipment move-in target: October 2026.

TSM.title: TSMC and Applied Materials Partner at $5B EPIC Center to Accelerate AI Chip Co-Innovation
TSM.content: TSMC and Applied Materials will co-innovate at AMAT's $5B EPIC Center in Silicon Valley to advance materials engineering and process integration for energy-efficient AI chips, accelerating lab-to-fab transitions for next-gen nodes.

TSM.title: TSMC Arizona Corporation Board Approves Up to $20B Capital Injection to Fund Fab Construction and Equipment
TSM.content: TSMC disclosed its U.S. subsidiary TSMC Arizona Corporation approved a capital increase plan authorizing up to $20B injection from parent TSMC, subject to regulatory approvals. Funds support large-scale fab construction and equipment spending under the US-Taiwan trade deal framework (15% tariff cap). Total Arizona investment on track toward $165B+; second fab P2 tool move-in target October 2026, targeting N2 and A16 process nodes.

TSM.title: TSMC Technology Symposium 2026: Global Chip Market $1.5T by 2030; AI/HPC to Reach 55% Share; 9 Fab Phases Planned
TSM.content: At annual Hsinchu technology symposium May 14, TSMC forecast global semiconductor market exceeding $1.5T by 2030: AI/HPC 55%, smartphones 20%, automotive 10%. TSMC planning 9 phases of wafer fab and advanced packaging facilities in 2026. Stock hit new ATH $421.97, market cap ~$2.2T. Quarterly dividend increased 17.2%.

TSM.title: TSMC April 2026 Revenue NT$410.7B +17.5% YoY; Board Approves NT$7/Share Q1 Dividend; Plans VIS Stake Sale
TSM.content: TSMC April 2026 revenue NT$410.73B (-1.1% MoM, +17.5% YoY). Board approved NT$7.0/share Q1 2026 cash dividend. Plans to sell 152M shares (~8.1%) of Vanguard International Semiconductor. Q2 2026 guidance: $39-40.2B revenue, 65.5-67.5% GM.

TSM.title: Bernstein: TSMC Poised for AI Growth Despite Lagging Semiconductor Index; 61% of Q1 Revenue from AI/HPC; N2 Arizona P2 Fab Tool Move-In October 2026
TSM.content: Bernstein analysts flag TSMC has lagged the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index despite fundamentally strong positioning: 61% of Q1 2026 revenue from AI and HPC; N2 Arizona fab (P2) on track for October 2026 equipment move-in as part of $465B US investment; consecutive annual price hikes (5-10% for AI/HPC nodes) already underway through 2029. Bernstein argues stock underperformance is sector-rotation noise — TSMC's structural monopoly on advanced AI chip manufacturing is intact. Q2 2026 guidance: $39-40.2B revenue, GM 65.5-67.5%.

TSM.title: TSMC Arizona Fab Q1 2026 Profit $514M — Exceeds Full-Year 2025; AI Demand "Significantly Outpaces Supply"
TSM.content: TSMC's first Arizona fab earned $514M profit in Q1 2026 alone, exceeding its entire 2025 earnings. Board approved additional $20B capital injection for TSMC Arizona on top of ~$31.3B in broader appropriations. "Demand still significantly outpaces supply," per Counterpoint Research analyst. Stock rose 2.3% May 20 and 1.36% May 21.

ASML.title: ASML Q1 2026: Net Sales €8.8B; 2026 Guidance Raised to €36-40B; High-NA EUV Enters High-Volume Manufacturing
ASML.content: ASML Q1 2026: net sales €8.8B (+13% YoY), net income €2.8B (+17%). 2026 guidance raised to €36-40B (from €34-39B). EUV revenue €4.1B (+28% YoY). Backlog €38.8B. China fell to 19% of system sales. High-NA EUV entering high-volume manufacturing.

ASML.title: ASML CEO: EUV Supply Cannot Meet Demand Through 2027; Targeting 80 Low-NA Systems in 2027
ASML.content: ASML CEO stated EUV supply will not meet demand in foreseeable future. Plans to ship 80 Low-NA EUV systems in 2027. AI infrastructure build-out represents binding constraint at equipment layer. Stock rose 3.48% on earnings day.

ASML.title: US MATCH Act (April 2, 2026): Bipartisan Bill to Ban DUV Exports and Servicing to China — Major Risk to ASML China Revenue
ASML.content: The MATCH Act proposes banning DUV immersion lithography exports and servicing to Chinese chipmakers (SMIC, Hua Hong, Huawei, CXMT, YMTC). China was 33% of ASML's 2025 revenue. Bill includes 150-day window for allied (Netherlands, Japan) cooperation before U.S. unilateral action. ASML shares fell on the April 7 announcement. Bill still requires Congressional passage; company guided China to ~20% of 2026 revenue.

ASML.title: ASML High-NA EUV Enters High-Volume Manufacturing; Next Q2 2026 Results Expected July 2026; China Now 19% of Sales vs 36% Prior Quarter
ASML.content: Following ASML Q1 2026 results (April 15), High-NA EUV lithography has entered high-volume manufacturing at leading-edge foundries. China fell to 19% of system sales in Q1 from 36% in Q4 2025 due to tightening export controls. 2026 revenue guidance raised to €36-40B. Next earnings Q2 2026 expected mid-July 2026. EUV supply remains demand-constrained through 2027 per CEO.

ASML.title: ASML CEO: High-NA EUV Nearing Commercial Production — First Sub-2nm Chips Expected Within Months; AI Demand Keeps Market Supply-Constrained
ASML.content: ASML CEO Christophe Fouquet: High-NA EUV approaching commercial application, first chips produced via High-NA EUV expected within months. Technology shrinks feature size ~66% vs current Low-NA EUV, enabling sub-2nm processes. Intel leading in High-NA EUV adoption. AI demand from Terafab, Starlink and hyperscalers will keep chip supply constrained for foreseeable future. Each High-NA EUV machine priced ~$400M.

AMAT.title: Applied Materials and TSMC Partner at $5B EPIC Center to Accelerate AI Chip Technologies
AMAT.content: Applied Materials and TSMC will co-innovate at AMAT's $5B EPIC Center in Silicon Valley to advance materials engineering, equipment innovation, and process integration for next-era AI chips from data center to edge.

AMAT.title: Bernstein: AI Agent Demand Drives Equipment Demand 'Off the Charts'; AMAT, ASML at Maximum Capacity
AMAT.content: Bernstein analyst: binding constraint for AI chip capacity has shifted from chip design to foundry production and semiconductor equipment. TSMC, ASML, and AMAT all running at maximum capacity; supply cannot meet AI demand.

AMAT.title: Applied Materials Q2 FY2026 Earnings Tomorrow (May 14): Consensus $7.69B Revenue, EPS $2.66; 20%+ SEM Growth Target Key
AMAT.content: AMAT reports Q2 FY2026 (ends April) results May 14 after close. Consensus: revenue $7.69B (+8.4% YoY), EPS $2.66 (+11.3% YoY); beat streak intact (4 consecutive quarters). Key catalyst: CFO target to deliver >20% semiconductor equipment business growth in calendar 2026. Focus on DRAM/HBM and advanced packaging demand. Morgan Stanley $454 target, Seaport Research Buy $500 target. AMAT-TSMC $5B EPIC Center partnership announced May 11.

AMAT.title: Applied Materials Q2 FY2026: Record Revenue $7.91B (+11% YoY); Non-GAAP EPS $2.86 (+20%); Dividend +15%; SEM Business to Grow >30% in 2026
AMAT.content: AMAT Q2 FY2026 (ended April 27): record revenue $7.91B (+11% YoY, beat $7.68B est), non-GAAP EPS $2.86 (+20% YoY, beat $2.68 est), non-GAAP GM 50.0% (record). Q3 guided revenue ~$8.25B. Semiconductor equipment business expected to grow >30% in calendar 2026. Raised quarterly dividend 15% to $0.53/share (9th consecutive annual increase). Announced acquisition of ASMPT's NEXX business (large-area advanced packaging deposition equipment) to strengthen panel-level packaging for AI accelerators.

AMAT.title: Morgan Stanley Cuts Applied Materials to Equal-Weight: China Share Concerns, In-Line 2027 Growth
AMAT.content: Morgan Stanley downgraded AMAT to Equal-weight; 2027 growth expected in-line with market, persistent China share concerns, valuation discount unlikely to narrow despite 2026 share gains. LRCX upgraded simultaneously.

KLAC.title: KLA Corp Gains 2.9% as AMAT-TSMC EPIC Center Partnership Signals Sustained Equipment Supercycle
KLAC.content: KLAC gained 2.89% following AMAT-TSMC EPIC Center announcement. Measurement and inspection tools are critical for AI chip yield at 3nm/2nm nodes. KLA running at maximum capacity alongside AMAT and ASML.

KLAC.title: TSMC and ASML Post-Earnings Signal Semiconductor Equipment Makers Like KLAC Are Key AI Bottleneck
KLAC.content: Following TSMC and ASML Q1 earnings, analysts note the binding constraint for AI chip capacity has shifted to equipment makers like ASML, Lam Research, and KLA. All running at maximum capacity to meet AI infrastructure buildout demand.

KLAC.title: KLA Corp Announces 10-for-1 Stock Split and 21% Dividend Increase — 17th Consecutive Annual Dividend Raise
KLAC.content: KLA Corp board approved a 10-for-1 forward stock split (record date June 4, trading on split-adjusted basis June 12, 2026 on Nasdaq as KLAC). Quarterly dividend raised 21% to $2.30/share pre-split ($0.23 post-split), the 17th consecutive annual dividend increase. CFO: split intended to improve share accessibility consistent with long-term capital allocation strategy. WFE industry 2026 forecast $140B (per LRCX); KLAC running at maximum capacity.

KLAC.title: KLA Corp: Shares Decline as Morgan Stanley Raises Broader WFE Forecast to $140B for 2026
KLAC.content: KLA shares under pressure amid sector rotation. Industry backdrop strong: WFE market forecast raised to $140B for 2026. KLA Q1 FY2026 revenue $3.4B (+6.6% YoY), GM 61.1%, benefiting from AI-driven advanced node investments by TSMC and Samsung.

ONTO.title: Onto Innovation Q1 2026: Revenue $292M (+10% Sequential); Advanced Packaging Revenue to Grow >50% in 2026
ONTO.content: ONTO Q1 2026 revenue $292M exceeded high end of guidance across all metrics. Dragonfly G5 initial commercial shipments and qualification at leading 2.5D logic customer. Advanced packaging (HBM/2.5D) expected to grow >50% in 2026. Full-year revenue growth >30% expected.

ONTO.title: Onto Innovation Announces $710M Strategic Investment for 27% Stake in Rigaku for AI-Enhanced X-Ray Metrology
ONTO.content: ONTO announced $710M strategic investment in Rigaku, acquiring 27% stake. Partnership integrates AI Diffract software into Rigaku X-ray metrology platforms to address advanced packaging inspection demands at HBM and CoWoS nodes.

ONTO.title: Onto Innovation Q1 2026 Revenue $300M+; HBM CoWoS Metrology Demand Drives Equipment Cycle
ONTO.content: ONTO Q1 2026 revenue continued growth driven by HBM and CoWoS advanced packaging metrology. TSMC CoWoS capacity expansion (for NVDA Blackwell) drives demand for ONTO's specialty inspection/measurement equipment.

SNPS.title: Synopsys Q1 FY2026 Earnings: Revenue $2.41B (+66% YoY) on Ansys Integration; Non-GAAP EPS $3.77, Backlog $11.3B
SNPS.content: SNPS Q1 FY2026: revenue $2.409B (+66% YoY), Design Automation $2.0B (+96%), non-GAAP EPS $3.77. Backlog $11.3B. Ansys integration progressing with joint solutions expected H1 2026 and monetization in FY2027.

SNPS.title: Elliott Management Takes Stake in Synopsys; Stock Down 23% From 52-Week High Despite EDA Dominance
SNPS.content: Elliott Management disclosed a stake in Synopsys while SNPS trades 23% below 52-week high. Activist involvement could accelerate strategic changes. Company unveiled AgentEngineer (2-5x EDA productivity) and Electronics Digital Twin Platform at Converge 2026.

SNPS.title: Synopsys Q2 FY2026 Earnings Scheduled May 27; Citi Raises PT to $600; Ansys Integration Ahead of $400M Target
SNPS.content: Synopsys will report Q2 FY2026 results May 27 after market close. Citi raised price target to $600 (from $580) on May 6. MU.content: MU Q2 FY2026: revenue $23.9B (+196% YoY), GAAP EPS $12.07. Q3 guidance: revenue $33.5B, gross margin ~81%. Entire 2026 HBM4 output sold out via binding contracts. Demand exceeds supply for all DRAM and NAND. Quarterly dividend increased 30%.

MU.title: Micron Stock Surges 15% to $746 on AI Memory Supercycle; HBM Now >30% of Total DRAM Revenue
MU.content: MU stock surged 15% to $746 as HBM supply stays sold out. HBM now >30% of total DRAM revenue vs <5% in 2022. Cantor Fitzgerald: 'structural supercycle for memory driven by AI workloads requiring an order of magnitude more memory per compute unit.'

MU.title: Micron Stock Up 700% Over Past Year; AI Memory Demand Still Far Outpacing Production Capacity
MU.content: MU shares up 700%+ over trailing 12 months driven by HBM3E and AI server DRAM demand. Micron executives confirmed demand for both DRAM and NAND far exceeds current supply capacity. Analysts see shares as relatively undervalued given earnings trajectory.

MU.title: Micron Gains 7.2% After Raising 2026 Capex to $20B for HBM Expansion; Stock Tests $800 on Samsung Strike Fears
MU.content: Micron gained 7.2% after announcing FY2026 capex raised to $20B to expand HBM4 and AI DRAM capacity. MU.title: Micron 2026 HBM Fully Sold Out Under Binding Contracts; Stock +150% YTD; Analysts Target $900-1000
MU.content: MU HBM3E production completely sold out for 2026 under binding contracts at record prices. Stock up 150% YTD (~$795). Consensus FY26 EPS $58; analyst targets $900-1000. Memory pricing power structural shift driven by AI multi-year contracts; memory no longer commodity.

MU.title: Micron Opens +4% as NVIDIA Q1 Data Center Revenue $75.2B Confirms HBM Super-Cycle Intact; Samsung Supply Uncertainty Adds Tailwind
MU.content: Micron stock opened up 4.14% on May 20 following NVIDIA Q1 FY2027 blowout (Data Center $75.2B, +92% YoY) confirming sustained HBM demand. MU.title: Micron +3.6% May 21: Samsung 18-Day Strike Threat Tightens HBM Supply; Melius and HSBC Raise Targets to $1,100
MU.content: MU gained 3.6% on May 21. Samsung Electronics labor unions announced an 18-day strike, threatening HBM supply from the world's largest memory producer. SNDK.title: Sandisk Q3 FY2026: Revenue $5.95B (+97% Sequential), GAAP EPS $23.03; Enterprise SSD Surges 233%
SNDK.content: SNDK Q3 FY2026: revenue $5.95B (beat $4.7B consensus by wide margin), GAAP net income $3.615B, EPS $23.03. Enterprise SSD +233% sequential on AI data center demand. SNDK.title: Sandisk Stock Up ~500% in 2026; QLC Stargate Launch Ready; High-Bandwidth Flash NAND on Track for Late 2026
SNDK.content: SNDK has surged ~500% in 2026 driven by AI data center NAND demand. QLC Stargate launch readiness confirmed. High-bandwidth flash NAND targeted for late 2026. BiCS 8 recognized as industry gold standard. CEO: 'fundamental inflection point' for the company.

SNDK.content: Mizuho raised SNDK price target to $1,625 from $1,220 (Outperform rating maintained), citing continued structural AI data center NAND storage demand. SNDK.content: SNDK stock continued its extraordinary 2026 run — up ~550% YTD at $1,398 as of May 12 — prompting Motley Fool analysis of sustainability. $42B backlog from three hyperscaler supply contracts; Q3 FY2026 enterprise SSD +233% sequentially; CEO: 'NAND is the only economically viable solution for AI inference capacity at scale.' SNDK.title: SanDisk Stock Drops 4.34% on Profit-Taking; Valuation Concerns After Major AI Memory Rally
SNDK.content: SNDK fell 4.34% on May 18 on valuation concerns despite strong operating backdrop. NAND memory demand remains robust for AI infrastructure but stock trading at premium to historical averages after massive 2026 rally.

SNDK.title: SanDisk Developing High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF): 8-16x HBM Capacity in Same Footprint; First Samples H2 2026
SNDK.content: SanDisk is developing High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) — NAND stacked vertically like HBM, offering 8-16x the capacity at lower cost per bit for AI inference serving. First HBF samples expected H2 2026. SanDisk did in months what Nvidia took years — transforming from consumer NAND to AI data center infrastructure. Q3 FY2026 datacenter revenue +645% YoY; $42B backlog from hyperscaler contracts.

COHR.title: Coherent Q3 FY2026: Revenue $1.81B, Non-GAAP EPS $1.41; Datacenter Revenue +41% YoY to $1.36B
COHR.content: COHR Q3 FY2026: non-GAAP EPS $1.41 (vs $1.39 consensus), revenue $1.81B. Datacenter & Communications +41% YoY to $1.36B, now 75% of total revenue. Coherent orders booked through 2028. Shares fell 10% on broad optical sector selloff despite beat.

COHR.content: AI-linked optical names sold off despite strong earnings. COHR -10%, LITE -7%, FN -8%. Market concerns about valuation after 2025 rally. Lumentum: demand far exceeds capacity; supply constraints to persist throughout 2026. Fundamentals remain strong.

COHR.content: Nvidia invested $2B in Coherent as part of a strategic co-packaged optics (CPO) partnership with multiyear supply agreement through end of decade. CPO is a $15B+ TAM central to scaling next-gen AI data center architectures; Raymond James raised target to $371, Stifel to $420.

COHR.title: Coherent Stock +40%+ Post NVIDIA $2B Investment; CPO Technology to Scale Next-Gen AI Data Centers Through Decade-End
COHR.content: Coherent shares surged 40%+ following the May 6 announcement of NVIDIA's $2B equity investment in the company, combined with Q3 FY2026 results showing record bookings with backlog visibility through 2028. COHR.content: AI optics stocks saw profit-taking pressure on May 18: COHR -6%, LITE -9%, AAOI -10%. Sector had run sharply on AI data center interconnect demand. Underlying demand thesis intact per analysts.

LITE.title: Lumentum Q3 FY2026: Revenue $808M (+100% YoY) on AI Datacenter Demand; Supply Constraints Persist Through 2026
LITE.content: LITE Q3 FY2026: revenue doubled YoY to $808M. Management: demand across multiple product lines far exceeds capacity; supply constraints expected throughout 2026. Stock fell ~3% in after-hours despite strong results on broad optical sector selloff.

LITE.title: Lumentum -9% in Profit-Taking Wave After Strong 2026 AI Optics Rally; LITE +17% Rebound Followed

FN.content: Fabrinet Q3 FY2026: revenue $1.21B (+39.3% YoY) driven by NVIDIA optical module manufacturing partnership and AI data center interconnect demand. Stock closed down 7.8% on broader optical sector rotation despite revenue growth.

FN.title: Fabrinet Q3 FY2026: Record Revenue $1.214B (+39% YoY); $32M Raytec Investment for CPO; Q4 Guided $1.25-1.29B
FN.content: Fabrinet Q3 FY2026: record revenue $1.214B (+39% YoY), EPS $3.72 vs $3.53 estimate; telecom +55%, non-optical communications +52%. FN.title: Fabrinet Q3 FY2026 Record Revenue and EPS; Q4 Revenue Guidance $1.25-1.29B

MSFT.title: Microsoft Q3 FY2026 Earnings: Azure and AI Growing Strongly; 2026 Capex ~$190B for AI Infrastructure

GOOGL.title: Google I/O 2026 Key Announcements: Gemini 3.5 Flash (4x Faster), Gemini Spark 24/7 AI Agent, Samsung Android XR Smart Glasses Fall 2026, AI Ultra $100/Month
GOOGL.content: Google I/O 2026 keynote (May 19): (1) Gemini 3.5 Flash — surpasses Gemini 3.1 Pro on coding/agentic/multimodal benchmarks, runs 4x faster, now powering Google Search AI Mode across all Google products and APIs. (2) Gemini Spark: 24/7 personal AI agent running on Google Cloud VMs autonomously without a device open; available first to AI Ultra subscribers. (3) Android XR smart glasses: unveiled with Samsung (hardware), Gentle Monster and Warby Parker (design); Gemini-powered all-day assistant via private earpiece; fall 2026 launch. (4) Google AI Ultra tier cut to $100/month for power users/developers. Strategic: each announcement reinforces GCP AI infrastructure demand and Alphabet's vertical AI integration from silicon (TPUs) to consumer devices.

GOOGL.title: Google I/O 2026 Day 2: Gemini 3.5 Flash Broadly Available at Half the Cost; Android XR Smart Glasses with Samsung Previewed for Fall 2026
GOOGL.content: Google I/O Day 2 developer sessions: Gemini 3.5 Flash broadly available — frontier-level capabilities at <50% cost of comparable frontier models. Android XR smart glasses (co-developed with Samsung) previewed for fall 2026 launch. Gemini Intelligence platform expands agentic AI on Android. Googlebooks laptop category launching fall 2026 with Acer, ASUS, Lenovo.

GOOGL.title: Google I/O 2026: Gemini 3.5 + Gemini Omni + Agentic AI Search Launched; GOOGL Upgraded to Strong Bullish
GOOGL.content: Google I/O 2026 (May 21-22): Alphabet unveiled Gemini 3.5, Gemini Omni (multimodal reasoning), and radically revamped agentic AI Search with autonomous task completion and real-time web access. New AI pricing model ties revenue to compute usage, supporting gross margin expansion. Seeking Alpha upgraded GOOGL to Strong Bullish; Google Cloud accelerated to 63% YoY growth in Q1 with $460B+ backlog.

AMZN.title: Amazon Q1 2026: AWS Growth at Highest Rate in 15 Quarters; Revenue $181.5B; 2026 Capex $200B
AMZN.content: AMZN Q1 2026: revenue $181.5B, net margin 16.7%. AWS cloud computing grew at highest rate in 15 quarters. 2026 capex plan maintained at ~$200B (majority for AI infrastructure). Trainium/Inferentia custom AI chips scaling in commercial deployments.

AMZN.title: Amazon Rated Best Hyperscaler Q1 2026 Report: AWS Reacceleration + Retail Margin Expansion
AMZN.content: AWS growth reacceleration combined with retail profit margin expansion led analysts to rank Amazon as top Q1 2026 performer among hyperscalers. Anthropic investment and Trainium custom AI chips positioning AWS for long-term AI workload capture.

AMZN.title: Amazon Invests Additional $25B in Anthropic; Anthropic Commits $100B+ to AWS and 1GW Trainium2/3 Capacity by Year-End
AMZN.content: Amazon committed additional $25B investment in Anthropic (valuation $380B): $5B immediate + $20B contingent on milestones. Anthropic in return commits $100B+ to AWS over 10 years including 1GW of Trainium2/3 capacity by year-end 2026. Deal mirrors Amazon's earlier $50B agreement with OpenAI. Anthropic cited explosive Claude demand as driver of infrastructure urgency.

AMZN.title: Amazon Trainium Chip Backlog Surpasses $225B; Business Crosses $20B Annual Run Rate; OpenAI Commits 2GW Starting 2027
AMZN.content: AWS Trainium revenue commitments exceed $225B — part of $364B total AWS backlog. Trainium/Graviton/Nitro combined chip business crossed $20B annualized run rate (+40% sequential). OpenAI committed to 2GW Trainium capacity starting 2027; Anthropic up to 5GW. Trainium2 delivers ~30% better price-performance vs comparable GPUs; Trainium3 another 30-40% improvement.

AMZN.title: Amazon Custom AI Silicon Crosses $20B Annual Run Rate; Trainium/Graviton/Nitro Strategy Reduces NVIDIA Dependency
AMZN.content: Amazon's custom AI chip business (Trainium, Graviton, Nitro) crossed $20B annualized run rate — raising strategic question of whether this displaces NVIDIA GPU spend or supplements it. Trainium2 delivers ~30% better price-performance vs comparable NVIDIA GPUs; Trainium3 adds another 30-40%. OpenAI committed 2GW Trainium capacity starting 2027; Anthropic up to 5GW. Combined with Anthropic's $100B+ AWS commitment, AWS custom silicon increasingly central to AI cloud strategy.

AMZN.title: AWS Expands Amazon Quick AI Assistant with Desktop App; Partners OpenAI to Bring GPT-5.5 to Bedrock
AMZN.content: AWS launched Amazon Quick AI work assistant (desktop app) and expanded OpenAI partnership: GPT-5.5 and GPT-4.5 on Amazon Bedrock (limited preview). AWS AI revenue run rate >$15B in Q1 FY2026; Bedrock processed more tokens in Q1 than all prior years combined.

AMZN.title: Wells Fargo Raises Amazon PT Citing "Significant AWS Trainium Expansion Ahead"; Bezos: "AI Fears Are Overblown"
AMZN.content: Wells Fargo raised Amazon price target citing substantial AWS Trainium custom AI chip capacity expansion ahead. Jeff Bezos publicly stated "AI fears are overblown," signaling confidence in long-term AI infrastructure investment. AWS Summits held May 20 in Hamburg and Seoul. AWS AI revenue run rate exceeds $15B annually. Court ruling favored Amazon data center expansion.

META.title: Meta Q1 2026: Revenue +33% YoY (Fastest Among Hyperscalers); 2026 Capex Raised to $125-145B
META.content: META Q1 2026: revenue $56.3B (+33%), fastest growth among hyperscaler group driven by AI-powered ad targeting via Llama models. 2026 capex raised to $125-145B. MTIA custom AI chip scaling. Net margin 47.5%. One Big Beautiful Bill Act tax reform impacts being managed.

META.title: Meta Commits to 6GW AMD Instinct GPU Deployment; Confirmed as One of World's Largest AI Compute Buyers
META.content: Meta announced deployment of up to 6GW of AMD Instinct GPUs including custom MI450. Combined with $125-145B capex, Meta is among the world's largest AI compute buyers. Llama open-source models and MTIA chips further deepen AI infrastructure vertical integration.

META.title: Zuckerberg Town Hall: Meta 2026 Layoffs Are Capex Reallocation to AI Infrastructure, Not AI Productivity Concerns
META.content: Mark Zuckerberg told employees that 2026 workforce reductions are budget reallocations toward AI infrastructure capex — not signals of AI replacing workers. Meta committed to $125-145B capex in 2026 (nearly double 2025), with nearly all directed to data centers, GPUs, and Llama model infrastructure. Meta Superintelligence Labs released its first model in Q1 2026. Stock initially fell ~10% on capex increase before recovering.

META.title: Meta Muse Spark: First Paid AI Model Marks Strategic Pivot Away From Open-Source Toward Monetization
META.content: Meta unveiled Muse Spark, its first commercial (paid) AI model — deviating from previous Llama open-source releases. The move mirrors OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google's paid API approach. Wall Street responded skeptically, wanting clearer AI revenue strategy beyond the $125-145B capex commitment. Analysts: AI monetization thesis requires demonstrated revenue from models, not just advertising efficiency gains.

META.title: Five Major Publishers Sue Meta Over Llama AI Training on Pirated Books — Class Action in Manhattan Federal Court
META.content: Elsevier, Cengage, Hachette, Macmillan, and McGraw Hill filed a class-action lawsuit in Manhattan federal court alleging Meta pirated millions of books and journal articles to train its Llama large language models without permission, payment, or license. Author Scott Turow is co-plaintiff. Case adds copyright litigation risk atop Meta's $125-145B capex AI buildout plan for 2026.

META.title: Meta Sued by Santa Clara County Over $Billions in Scam Advertisements; Chinese Regulators Block Manus AI Acquisition
META.content: Santa Clara County, California filed suit against Meta alleging the company knowingly facilitates and profits from billions of scam advertisements across Facebook and Instagram. Separately, Chinese regulators blocked Meta's proposed acquisition of AI startup Manus citing geopolitical and regulatory concerns — a setback for Meta's AI strategy in Asia. META stock up 33% YoY in Q1 but down in May on litigation and capex overspend concerns.

META.title: Meta Q1 2026 Summary: Net Income +61% YoY; 2026 AI Capex Raised to $125-145B; Q2 Revenue Guide $59.5B (+25% YoY)
META.content: Meta Platforms Q1 2026: net income grew 61% YoY despite elevated AI capex. Raised FY2026 capex guidance to $125-145B from $115-135B due to higher component costs and additional data center capacity for future years. Q2 2026 revenue midpoint guide $59.5B (+25% YoY). Daily active users declined slightly in Q1 due to Iran internet disruptions and Russia WhatsApp restrictions.

META.title: Meta Confirms 10% Workforce Cut (~8,000 Jobs) on May 20 to Redirect Billions to AI
META.content: Meta will execute 10% workforce reduction (~8,000 employees) on May 20 as Zuckerberg redirects capital toward AI. 2026 capex guidance raised to $125-145B. Muse Spark new AI model departing from Llama open-source model. Acquired Assured Robot Intelligence for humanoid robots.

META.title: Meta 10% Workforce Reduction Begins May 20: 8,000 Cut + 6,000 Roles Cancelled; 7,000 Redeployed to AI Teams
META.content: Execution of Meta's 10% workforce reduction began May 20: 8,000 employees cut, 6,000 open positions cancelled, 7,000 employees reorganized into new AI-focused roles. Largest workforce overhaul in Meta's history. CEO Zuckerberg told employees no further company-wide layoffs expected in 2026. Reflects AI-first organizational pivot alongside record $72B+ capex guidance.

AAPL.title: Apple Q2 FY2026: Revenue $111.2B (+17% YoY), iPhone +22%; Apple Intelligence Driving Upgrade Cycle
AAPL.content: AAPL Q2 FY2026: revenue $111.2B (+17% YoY), EPS +22%. iPhone segment $57B (+22% YoY). Apple Intelligence AI features driving hardware upgrade cycle and Services growth. Gross margin 49.3%. Strong performance despite macro headwinds.

AAPL.title: Apple, Nvidia, Microsoft Trading at Best Valuations in Years Amid AI-Driven Earnings Growth
AAPL.content: AAPL, NVDA, MSFT trading at historically attractive valuations relative to earnings growth trajectory. Apple Intelligence hardware cycle, Services monetization, and M-series chip advantage in edge AI create multi-year earnings expansion case.

AAPL.title: Apple Authorizes $100B Buyback, Raises Dividend 4% to $0.27; Seeks Refund of Supreme Court-Struck IEEPA Tariffs; June Q Revenue Guide +14-17%
AAPL.content: Q2 FY2026 earnings: Apple's Board authorized $100B additional share repurchases and raised quarterly dividend 4% to $0.27/share (payable May 14, record date May 11). CEO Cook confirmed Apple pursuing refunds on IEEPA tariffs recently struck down by the Supreme Court, with refunds to be reinvested in U.S. advanced manufacturing above prior $500B commitment. June quarter revenue guided +14-17% YoY despite Mac supply constraints and tariff headwinds.

AAPL.title: Wedbush Sets $400 Apple Price Target — Highest on Street — as AI Hardware Cycle Drives Services Ecosystem Growth
AAPL.content: Wedbush analyst Dan Ives raised Apple price target to $400 — highest on Wall Street — citing Apple Intelligence hardware upgrade cycle and Services monetization. iOS 27 multi-AI-model architecture (supporting Google Gemini and others) expected to drive hundreds of AI-based app monetization opportunities through the App Store. iPhone revenue +22% YoY in Q2 FY2026; Apple Intelligence increasingly a hardware replacement catalyst.

AAPL.title: Apple-Google Gemini Deal: Google AI to Power Next-Gen Siri via iOS 27 Multi-Model AI Framework
AAPL.content: Apple and Google formally announced a multi-year deal where Google's Gemini models power the next generation of Apple Foundation Models, including a rebuilt Siri in iOS 27. iOS 27 will allow users to switch between multiple AI providers — Gemini, OpenAI, and Apple's own models. Wedbush projects this creates an 'AI toll booth' on the App Store as developers integrate Gemini and other AI APIs into iPhone apps.

AAPL.title: Apple CEO Tim Cook Joins Trump China Delegation (May 13-15 Beijing); iPhone Tariff Relief and Supply Chain on Agenda
AAPL.content: Apple CEO Tim Cook joined President Trump's May 13-15 China state visit to Beijing alongside Tesla's Elon Musk and executives from Qualcomm, Citi, Goldman Sachs, Cargill, and Visa. Apple likely seeking tariff relief on iPhone/Mac China manufacturing and supply chain assurances. AAPL Q2 FY2026 revenue $111.2B (+17% YoY); company previously pursuing IEEPA tariff refunds from Supreme Court ruling to reinvest in U.S. manufacturing. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was notably not invited.

AAPL.title: Tim Cook Beijing Trip: CEO Meets Xi Jinping, Signals Apple All-In on China; $500B US Investment Pledge Backdrop
AAPL.content: Tim Cook visited Beijing; Xi Jinping told assembled executives including Cook that China would open wider for their businesses. Apple Q2 2026: revenue $111.2B (+17% YoY), $100B buyback authorized. 80% of production still in China.

TSLA.title: Tesla Robotaxi Expands to Dallas and Houston; FSD Subscriptions Hit 1.28M (+51% YoY)
TSLA.content: Tesla Robotaxi went live in Dallas and Houston (April 18), expanding beyond Austin and Bay Area. FSD subscriptions reached 1.28M in Q1 2026 (+51% YoY). Management targeting a dozen U.S. states by year end. Large-scale unsupervised ramp remains 2027 per Musk on software architecture improvements.

TSLA.title: Piper Sandler: Tesla Optimus Robot Valued at Zero in Current ~$400 Stock Price; FSD/Robotaxi Key to Bull Case
TSLA.content: Piper Sandler analyst Alex Potter: Optimus humanoid robot effectively valued at zero in current ~$400/share price despite production ramp underway. Bull case anchored on FSD/Robotaxi scaling in 2027 and robot optionality on top.

TSLA.title: Tesla Optimus Factory Preparations Begin Q2: Fremont Line Targets 1M Robots/Year; FSD v14.3 Cuts Inference Latency 20%
TSLA.content: Tesla beginning preparations for first large-scale Optimus factory at Fremont (first-gen line: 1M robots/year) and Gigafactory Texas (second-gen: 10M robots/year long-term target) in Q2 2026. FSD v14.3 launched April with reinforcement learning upgrades, improved neural encoder, AI compiler, and 20% lower inference latency. Unsupervised Robotaxi now operating in Austin, Dallas, and Houston; targeting a dozen U.S. states by year-end.

TSLA.title: Tesla Rallies 54% From November Low to $421; Optimus Factory Q2 Preparations Begin at Fremont and Gigafactory Texas
TSLA.content: TSLA closed May 11 at $420.84 — up 54% from the November 2025 low of $273. Q2 2026: Optimus factory preparations begin at Fremont (first-gen line: 1M robots/year capacity) and Gigafactory Texas (10M robots/year long-term). Robotaxi operational in Austin, Dallas, Houston; FSD v14.3 with 20% lower inference latency in active deployment; FSD subscribers 1.3M (+51% YoY). Piper Sandler: Optimus effectively valued at zero in current share price.

TSLA.title: Elon Musk Joins Trump China Trip as Tesla Seeks EV Market Recovery; 2026 Model Y Passes NHTSA ADAS Tests
TSLA.content: Elon Musk joins Trump's May 13-15 China state visit delegation, with Tesla seeking EV market access recovery and supply chain stability. Separately, NHTSA confirmed Tesla's 2026 Model Y successfully passed ADAS tests for pedestrian emergency braking, lane-keeping, and blind-spot warnings — a regulatory milestone supporting Tesla's FSD and Robotaxi expansion. TSLA stock up 54% from November 2025 low; Optimus factory preparations underway at Fremont and Gigafactory Texas.

TSLA.title: Tesla FSD v14.3 Launches with 20% Lower Inference Latency; Model S/X Fremont Lines Shut to Enable Optimus Robot Factory
TSLA.content: Tesla launched FSD (Supervised) v14.3 with 20% lower inference latency, improved vision perception, and enhanced edge case handling. Model S/X production lines at Fremont permanently closed to make way for Optimus humanoid robot factory targeting 1M robots/year. Tesla also received EU FSD approval in Netherlands. Q1 2026 FSD subscribers: 1.3M (up from ~850K a year ago).

TSLA.title: Wedbush: SpaceX and Tesla to Merge in 2027; SpaceX Confirms New Tesla Collaboration Exploration; India Facility Plans Dropped
TSLA.content: Wedbush analyst Dan Ives reported SpaceX and Tesla "will eventually merge into one company in 2027." SpaceX publicly confirmed plans to explore expanded Tesla collaboration. Tesla ended plans to build India manufacturing facility. Q1 2026: EPS $0.41 beat estimates, energy storage margins hit record 39.5%. Stock at $414 range.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Q1 2026: Revenue $2.1B (+112% YoY), Backlog $99.4B Approaching $100B; 2026 Guide $12-13B
CRWV.content: CRWV Q1 2026: revenue $2.1B (+112% YoY, +32% sequential). Backlog $99.4B (+50% QoQ). Active power surpassed 1GW; targeting 1.7GW by end 2026. 2026 capex guidance $31-35B. Full-year revenue guidance $12-13B maintained. Adj operating income $900M-$1.1B.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Stock Falls ~10% on Wider-Than-Expected Loss Despite Record Backlog Near $100B
CRWV.content: CRWV stock fell ~10% post-earnings as Q1 EPS of -$1.11 missed -$0.87 estimate. Despite backlog approaching $100B and revenues tripling YoY, heavy capex ($31-35B in 2026) and persistent net losses concerned investors. Revenue guidance $12-13B for 2026 maintained.

CRWV.title: Magnetar Capital Sells $164.4M of CoreWeave Shares; Post-Earnings EPS Miss Raises Profitability Concerns
CRWV.content: Magnetar Capital funds disclosed $164.4M sale of CRWV shares following post-earnings ~10% decline. Q1 EPS of -$1.40 significantly missed -$0.87 estimate despite $2.1B revenue (+112% YoY) and $99.4B backlog. 2026 capex guidance $31-35B with persistent net losses raises investor concerns about path to profitability. Revenue guidance $12-13B for full 2026 maintained.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Q2 2026 Revenue Guide $2.45-2.6B Misses $2.69B Consensus; $95B Backlog Includes Jane Street $6B Deal
CRWV.content: CoreWeave Q2 2026 guided $2.45-2.6B, with the midpoint trailing analyst consensus of $2.69B. Despite strong Q1 (revenue $2.1B +112% YoY, backlog $99.4B), cautious Q2 guide added to post-earnings investor concerns. Committed pipeline exceeds $95B including $21B Meta agreement and a new $6B deal with Jane Street signed April 2026. CRWV targeting $12-13B full-year 2026 revenue and 1.7GW active power by year-end.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Secures $3.1B GPU-Backed HPC Infrastructure Loan; Jane Street $6B Deal + Nvidia $2B Equity Investment
CRWV.content: CRWV secured $3.1B DDTL 5.0 GPU-backed loan (oversubscribed). Separately, Jane Street will pay ~$6B for AI cloud access + $1B equity at $109/share; Nvidia bought additional $2B CRWV shares in Q1. Backlog: $99.4B.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Q1 2026 Revenue $2.08B (Doubled YoY); EPS Miss Triggers 13% Drop; Rebounds +5% on NVDA Q2 Guide
CRWV.content: CoreWeave Q1 2026: revenue ~$2.08B (doubled YoY, beat), but EPS missed, triggering ~13% post-earnings decline. Stock recovered +5% on May 21 following NVDA's strong Q2 guidance ($91B), confirming AI data center GPU demand. Short interest at 14%. Capital-intensive GPU cloud model faces debt scrutiny despite strong revenue growth.

CEG.title: Constellation Energy Q1 2026: EPS $2.74 Beats $2.59 Estimate; Revenue $11.12B; Calpine Drives Near-Doubling of Revenue
CEG.content: CEG Q1 2026: GAAP net income $1.59B (vs $118M a year ago), adj EPS $2.74 (vs $2.59 est). Revenue $11.12B (beat $9B estimate) thanks to Calpine acquisition consolidation in January 2026. Nuclear capacity factor 92.3%. Full-year adj EPS guidance $11.00-$12.00 affirmed.

CEG.title: Constellation Energy Freestone Site Approved for Large Data Center Co-Location; Pin Oak Creek 460MW Online
CEG.content: CEG Q1 update: Freestone site secured regulatory approval to co-locate a large data center, expanding nuclear power AI supply capacity. Pin Oak Creek 460MW natural gas facility reached commercial operation. 105MW Pastoria Solar commissioned.

CEG.title: Constellation Energy CEO Affirms 20% Long-Term EPS Growth Target; Ranked #1 on Barron's Most Sustainable U.S. Companies
CEG.content: Constellation Energy Q1 2026 earnings call: CEO affirmed 20% long-term earnings growth target. Ranked #1 on Barron's 2026 Most Sustainable U.S. Companies list. Nuclear PTC portfolio and AI data center power agreements provide multi-year revenue visibility.

CEG.title: Constellation Energy Q1 2026: Revenue +64% to $11.12B; Crane Nuclear Plant Awaiting Regulator Restart Decision
CEG.content: CEG Q1 2026: Adjusted EPS $2.74, revenue $11.12B (+64% YoY, includes Calpine). Crane Clean Energy Center (Three Mile Island) restart awaiting NRC decision; may not supply grid until 2031. FY 2026 adj. EPS guidance $11-12 reaffirmed. $4B growth capex planned.

VRT.title: Vertiv Q1 2026: Revenue $2.6B (+30% YoY), Adj EPS +83%; Full-Year Guide Raised to $13.5-14B
VRT.content: VRT Q1 2026: revenue $2.6B (+30% YoY, +23% organic), adj EPS +83%, adj operating margin 20.8%. Full-year 2026 guidance raised to $13.5-14B with 30% organic growth and 51% earnings growth. Backlog >$15B driven by AI data center liquid cooling and power demand.

VRT.title: Vertiv Stock Hits Record High as AI Demand Drives 80% Backlog Surge Year-Over-Year
VRT.content: VRT stock reaches record high after guidance raised to $14B. Backlog surged 80% YoY on AI data center liquid cooling and power infrastructure demand. Liquid cooling penetration rate inflection point a key long-term growth driver.

VRT.title: White House Invokes Defense Production Act: Power Grid as National Security — VRT, ETN, GEV Designated Beneficiaries for Accelerated Procurement
VRT.content: White House invoked Defense Production Act (April 20) classifying power grid and baseload energy systems as national security assets. Energy Dept authorized to accelerate procurement — direct purchases, guarantees, and regulatory approvals — for critical grid equipment. Vertiv (liquid cooling, power infrastructure), Eaton, and GE Vernova are primary beneficiaries. >50% of 2026 US data centers face delays from transformer/switchgear shortages.

VRT.title: Citi Raises Vertiv Price Target to Street-High $414; Stock Hits New 52-Week High at $365 — Up 108% YTD
VRT.content: Citi raised Vertiv Holdings price target to a Street-high $414, citing $15B+ backlog visibility from AI data center liquid cooling and power infrastructure. VRT shares hit new 52-week high at $365.25 (up 108% YTD). Management guides 51% adjusted earnings growth and 30% organic revenue growth in 2026 on accelerating AI data center buildout demand.

VRT.title: Vertiv Schedules May 19-20 Investor Conference in Greenville SC; 2026-2027 Financial Outlook to Be Presented
VRT.content: Vertiv announced a two-day investor conference May 19-20, 2026 in Greenville, South Carolina. Management will discuss strategic initiatives, product innovations, and financial outlook. VRT stock hit 52-week high $365.25 (+108% YTD) after Citi raised target to Street-high $414. Conference follows Q1 2026 record: revenue $2.6B (+30% YoY), backlog >$15B, adj EPS +83%, organic growth guidance 30% for 2026.

VRT.title: Vertiv Q1 2026: Revenue $2.65B +30% YoY; Adjusted EPS +83%; Raises Full-Year Guidance to $13.5-14B
VRT.content: VRT Q1 2026: Net sales $2.65B (+30% YoY), Adj. EPS growth +83%, Americas organic growth +44%. Raised FY2026 guidance to $13.5-14B net sales, 29-31% organic growth. Adj. FCF $653M (+147% YoY). Liquid cooling demand accelerating.

VRT.title: Vertiv 2026 Investor Conference Opens in Greenville SC: Financial Outlook, Liquid Cooling Strategy, 2027-2028 Targets Presented
VRT.content: Vertiv two-day Investor Conference opened May 19 in Greenville, SC; technology-focused presentations continue May 20. Management presenting FY2026 financial outlook (raised guidance: $13.5-14B net sales, adj EPS $6.30-6.40 at +51% midpoint), liquid cooling product innovations, and 2027-2028 multi-year targets. Webcast and materials available at investors.vertiv.com. VRT stock opened down 3.16% on May 19 ahead of event. $15B+ backlog remains primary demand visibility indicator; liquid cooling penetration inflection continues.

VRT.title: Vertiv Q1 2026 Update: $15B Backlog (+109% YoY), Organic Orders +252% YoY; TD Cowen PT $387, RBC $435
VRT.content: Vertiv Q1 2026: $15B backlog (+109% YoY), organic orders +252% YoY, driven by AI data center liquid cooling and power demand. TD Cowen raised PT to $387 from $347 (Buy); RBC raised to $435 from $356 (Outperform). Liquid cooling backlog provides strong multi-year revenue visibility as GPU cluster power density increases.

ETN.title: Eaton Q1 2026 Record Revenue $7.5B (+17%); Data Center Orders +240% YoY; Electrical Backlog +48%; Raises Guide
ETN.content: ETN Q1 2026: record revenue $7.5B (+17%), adj EPS $2.81. Data center orders +240% YoY. Electrical backlog +48% YoY. Boyd Thermal acquisition closed March 2026 (liquid cooling, $1.7B+ 2026 revenue). Full-year organic growth guidance raised to +10% midpoint.

ETN.title: Eaton Boyd Thermal Acquisition Doubles Liquid Cooling Revenue; 12 New Factories Ramping for Data Center Demand
ETN.content: Boyd Thermal Q1 revenues more than doubled YoY adding liquid cooling to Eaton's data center portfolio. 12 new factories ramping (temporary margin headwind). Electrical Americas exit rate north of 30% margin targeted for H2 2026.

ETN.title: White House Defense Production Act: Power Grid Emergency — Eaton 11-Year Backlog, 50%+ of 2026 Data Centers Facing Delays
ETN.content: Defense Production Act designation of power grid as national security (April 20) accelerates federal procurement for electrical equipment. Eaton's data center electrical backlog equivalent to 11 years of 2025 construction activity. Industry data: >50% of planned 2026 U.S. data centers face delays or cancellations due to transformer and switchgear shortages — Eaton's core product categories. ETN up 17% YoY in Q1 2026.

ETN.title: Eaton Data Center Electrical Backlog Equivalent to 11 Years of 2025 Construction; Q1 2026 Record Revenue $7.5B Raises Guidance
ETN.content: Eaton's data center electrical backlog represents approximately 11 years of prior construction activity; the company's data center orders surged 240% YoY in Q1 2026. Record revenue $7.5B (+17%) and raised organic growth guidance to 10% midpoint. Boyd Thermal acquisition (liquid cooling) closed March 2026, adding $1.7B+ in 2026 revenue. 12 new factories ramping with temporary margin headwind. Electrical Americas targeting exit rate >30% operating margin in H2 2026.

ETN.title: Eaton Q1 2026: Electrical Americas Data Center Orders +240%, Revenue +50%; NVIDIA Grid-to-Chip Platform Launch
ETN.content: ETN Q1 2026: Electrical Americas data center orders +240% YoY, revenue +50%. Total electrical backlog +48% YoY. Launched Eaton Beam Rubin DSX 'grid-to-chip' platform with NVIDIA. Closed Boyd Thermal acquisition. New Nebraska switchgear plant committed.

GEV.title: GE Vernova Q1 2026: Revenue $9.3B (+16%), Orders $10B (+59% Organic); Backlog $163B; Data Center Orders $2.4B
GEV.content: GEV Q1 2026: revenue $9.3B (+16% YoY), orders $10B (+59% organic). Total backlog $163B (+$13B QoQ). Electrification segment booked $2.4B data center equipment orders in Q1 alone, exceeding all of 2025. Gas Power remains sold out. 2026 guidance raised.

GEV.title: GE Vernova and Vertiv Q1 Confirm AI Power Infrastructure Supercycle; $1.4T Needed for Data Centers by 2030
GEV.content: GEV and VRT earnings confirm AI power demand is structural. Industry projects $1.4 trillion in AI data center electrification by 2030. Grid equipment lead times and transformer availability remain supply-constrained, pricing power with GEV, ETN, VRT.

GEV.title: GE Vernova Up 65% YTD, Among Top S&P 500 Performers; Gas Turbine Slots Sold Through 2030; Targets 20GW Annualized Output Q3 2026
GEV.content: GE Vernova up 65% YTD, one of the strongest-performing S&P 500 industrials. Gas turbine slots sold out through 2030; targeting 20GW annualized gas turbine output by Q3 2026 and 24GW by 2028. Q1 data center orders $2.4B — more than all of 2025. Backlog $163B (+$13B QoQ). TIME magazine named GEV among 2026 Most Influential Companies. GEV per TIME: 'turning energy uncertainty into a business advantage.'

GEV.title: White House Defense Production Act: GE Vernova Gas Turbines and Grid Equipment Classified as National Defense Priority Assets
GEV.content: Trump White House invoked Defense Production Act (April 20) classifying power grid and baseload energy as national defense priority. Energy Dept can now accelerate procurement via direct purchases and guarantees for GEV gas turbines and grid equipment. GEV is the primary U.S. manufacturer for grid expansion — backlog $163B, turbine slots sold through 2030 — now with strategic federal procurement backing.

GEV.title: GE Vernova Gas Turbine Backlog Surpasses 100GW; Texas 2.5GW Hybrid Nuclear-Gas Plant Announced with Blue Energy
GEV.content: GE Vernova gas turbine backlog reached 100GW (up from 83GW at end-2025) with prices rising 5-10% YoY as demand exceeds supply through 2030. GEV.title: GE Vernova and ENKA Mark Commercial Operation of Turkey's First HA-Powered Plant (852MW) at Kirklareli

ORCL.title: Oracle OCI Enterprise AI Launches with Grok 4.3 and NVIDIA Nemotron; RPO Backlog Hits $523B
ORCL.content: Oracle Q2 FY2026: Cloud revenue $8B (+34% YoY), IaaS +68% to $4.1B. Remaining Performance Obligations hit $523B (+$68B). OCI Enterprise AI launched with Grok 4.3 and NVIDIA Nemotron models. DoW AI deployment agreement signed May 1.

ORCL.title: Bank of America Initiates Oracle at Buy, $200 Price Target: "Giant Going All-In on AI Infrastructure and Cloud"
ORCL.content: BofA analyst Tal Liani initiated Oracle at Buy, $200 PT, describing ORCL as "a giant going all-in on AI infrastructure and cloud." PLTR.title: Palantir Q1 2026: Revenue +85% YoY to $1.63B (Fastest Since IPO); US Revenue +104%; Raises FY2026 Guide to 71% Growth
PLTR.content: Palantir Q1 2026: revenue $1.63B (+85% YoY), adj EPS $0.33 beat $0.28 estimate, 60% adj operating margin. US revenue +104% (government +84%, commercial +133%). PLTR.title: Palantir Creates Stock Market History: 85% Revenue Growth + 57% FCF Margin — Rare Hyper-Growth Profitability Pairing
PLTR.content: Following record Q1 2026 results, Palantir achieved historic stock market milestones as one of very few large-cap companies combining hyper-growth (85% revenue) with high profitability (57% FCF margin). AIP platform adoption in DoD and enterprise sectors driving both growth vectors simultaneously.

PLTR.title: DoD FY2027 Budget Proposes $2.3B for Palantir Maven Smart System — Highest Ever Single-Program Allocation
PLTR.content: Palantir disclosed on Q1 2026 earnings call that the DoD FY2027 budget proposal includes $2.3B specifically allocated for Maven Smart System — providing multi-year revenue visibility significantly above current annual run rate for the program. PLTR.title: Palantir Rises 2.9% in Sympathy with Cisco Blowout; FY2026 Revenue Guide $7.65-7.66B (+71% YoY Above Consensus)
PLTR.content: PLTR rose 2.9% on May 14, lifted by Cisco's blowout Q3 results boosting software/AI infrastructure sector sentiment. Palantir FY2026 guide: $7.65-7.66B (+71% YoY) well above $7.27B consensus. Q1 2026 (May 4): revenue $1.63B vs $1.54B est, EPS $0.33 vs $0.27 est.

PLTR.title: Palantir Raises FY2026 Guidance to 71% Revenue Growth After Q1 +85% YoY Record; DoD AI Deployments Surge
PLTR.content: PLTR Q1 2026: Revenue $1.63B (+85% YoY, fastest since IPO), US Revenue +104%, non-GAAP EPS $0.33 vs $0.28 est. FY2026 guidance raised to $7.65-7.66B (71% growth, 10 points above prior guidance). Net income quadrupled to $870.5M.

PLTR.title: Deutsche Bank Raises Palantir PT to $200 (from $160), Maintains Hold — Clearest AI Winner But Expensive Valuation
PLTR.content: Deutsche Bank raised PLTR target to $200 from $160, keeping Hold due to premium valuation. Stock expensive on traditional metrics but AI monetization visibility highest in software sector.

IREN.title: IREN Acquires Mirantis for ~$625M All-Stock to Strengthen AI Cloud Delivery; 1,500+ Enterprise Kubernetes Customers
IREN.content: IREN signed a definitive agreement to acquire Mirantis — a Kubernetes orchestration provider serving 1,500+ enterprise customers — for ~$625M in all-stock. Mirantis is a founding ISV partner of the NVIDIA AI Cloud Ready Initiative, strengthening IREN's managed AI cloud capabilities and enterprise software layer.

IREN.title: IREN Secures $3.4B Five-Year NVIDIA AI Cloud Contract; NVIDIA Receives Warrants for 30M Shares at $70 (~$2.1B)
IREN.content: IREN signed a five-year ~$3.4B managed GPU cloud services contract with NVIDIA, granting NVIDIA the right to purchase up to 30M IREN shares at $70/share (~$2.1B warrants). Underpins IREN's plan to deploy up to 5GW of NVIDIA-designed AI infrastructure; stock surged 13% on May 8.

IREN.title: IREN Acquires Nostrum Group: Enters Europe with 490MW Secured Power in Spain; Global Portfolio Reaches 5GW
IREN.content: IREN agreed to acquire Ingenostrum S.L. (Nostrum Group), a Spanish data center developer with ~490MW grid-connected power in Spain plus an additional development pipeline — expanding IREN's total secured global power portfolio to 5GW.

IREN.title: IREN Q3 FY2026 Revenue $144.8M Misses $219.9M Estimate as Bitcoin-to-AI Infrastructure Pivot Continues
IREN.content: IREN Q3 FY2026 revenue $144.8M significantly missed analyst consensus of ~$219.9M as the company continues pivot from Bitcoin mining to AI infrastructure. Revenue miss was overshadowed by the simultaneous NVIDIA $3.4B contract, Mirantis, and Nostrum announcements the same week.

IREN.title: IREN Launches $2B Convertible Notes Offering to Fund AI Infrastructure Expansion; Shares Fall ~10%
IREN.content: IREN announced a $2B convertible notes offering to fund AI infrastructure expansion, sending shares down ~9.9% to $55.15 as investors digested dilution risk following the prior week's 13% surge on the NVIDIA deal announcement.

IREN.title: IREN Rallies on NVDA Blowout Q2 Guidance; $5.6B NVDA Cloud/Equity Deal; Short Interest 16%
IREN.content: IREN shares rose May 21 following NVDA's $91B Q2 guidance. IREN holds a $5.6B combined cloud services and potential equity deal with Nvidia (5-year right to purchase 30M shares at $70). Short interest 16% as traders bet against AI infrastructure debt load. Company transitioning from Bitcoin mining to dedicated AI GPU data center infrastructure.

VST.title: Vistra Q1 2026: Net Income $1.03B; EPS $2.87 Beats by 30%; 2026 Adjusted EBITDA Guidance $6.8-7.6B Reaffirmed
VST.content: Vistra Q1 2026: GAAP net income $1.029B (vs -$268M a year ago), EPS $2.87 beat $2.21 consensus by 30%. Revenue $5.64B (from $3.93B). Reaffirmed 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance $6.8-7.6B. Retail and generation expansion supports AI data center direct power supply strategy.

VST.title: Vistra Achieves Investment-Grade at Both S&P and Fitch; Dual Rating Triggers Lien Release, Lowers Capital Cost
VST.content: Fitch upgraded Vistra to BBB- (investment grade), joining S&P's December 2025 upgrade. VST.title: Vistra Signs Long-Term PPA with Meta for 2,600MW Nuclear Power at PJM Sites; Stock Pulls Back 25% From February Peak
VST.content: Vistra signed a long-term power purchase agreement with Meta for ~2,600MW of nuclear generation capacity at Vistra's PJM nuclear plants — one of the largest AI data center clean power deals announced. VST.title: Vistra Upgraded to Investment Grade at Second Major Rating Agency; Q1 2026 EBITDA $1.49B, Guidance Reaffirmed
VST.content: Vistra upgraded to investment grade at second major credit rating agency. Q1 2026: GAAP net income $1,029M, Adjusted EBITDA $1,494M. Reaffirmed 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance $6.8-7.6B, Adjusted FCF $3.925-4.725B.

MPWR.title: Monolithic Power Q1 2026: Record Revenue $804M (+26% YoY); Raises Capacity Target to $6B; Q2 Guided ~$900M; AI Server Growth 85% YoY
MPWR.content: MPWR Q1 2026: record revenue $804M (+26% YoY, +7% QoQ), adj EPS $5.10 beat $4.90 estimate. Raised manufacturing capacity target to $6B (from $4B). Q2 guided ~$900M. Enterprise data (AI servers DrMOS/VRM for NVIDIA H100/B200) growth raised to 85% YoY from prior 50% floor.

MPWR.title: Multiple Analysts Raise MPWR Price Targets After Q1 Beat and 85% AI Server Growth Guidance
MPWR.content: Multiple analysts raised MPWR price targets following Q1 2026 beat and enterprise data growth upgrade to 85% YoY. Communications segment grew 33% sequentially. Structural position in AI server power delivery (DrMOS/VRM) cited as a durable multi-year growth driver for MPWR.

MPWR.title: Monolithic Power Records +18% One-Month Return; $6B Capacity Target Set; Raymond James Raises to $1,800
MPWR.content: Monolithic Power Systems shares have returned +18% in the past month following Q1 2026 record results. MPWR.title: Monolithic Power Systems Q1 2026 Record Revenue +26% YoY; AI Server DrMOS/VRM Demand Leads; Stock at $1,534
MPWR.content: MPWR Q1 2026: record revenue, up 26% YoY, led by enterprise data and AI communications segment. DrMOS and VRM power management chips for NVDA H100/B200 servers driving growth.
