GLW.content: GLW jumped 12% on NVIDIA partnership. GLW.content: Corning and Meta announced a multiyear agreement worth up to $6B through 2030 for optical fiber, cable, and connectivity solutions for Meta's AI data centers. GLW.title: Bank of America Adds Corning to US 1 List; GLW Surges 10%+ on AI Infrastructure Optical Supply Role

GLW.title: Corning +324% Over Past Year Driven by AI Optical Demand; NVIDIA Partnership for 10x US Optical Production
GLW.content: GLW stock up 324% over past year, +123% YTD. Key catalyst: NVIDIA multiyear partnership to 10x US optical manufacturing capacity in North Carolina. Q1 2026 revenue $4.14B (+7.3% YoY). Optical telecom segment driven by AI data center fiber demand.

CRDO.title: Credo Technology Q3 FY2026: Revenue $407M (+201% YoY); Three Hyperscalers >10% Each; AEC Active Cable Ramp Accelerates
CRDO.content: Credo Q3 FY2026 (ended Jan 31): revenue $407M surging 201.5% YoY and 51.9% QoQ, non-GAAP GM 68.6%, EPS $1.07. Three hyperscalers each represented >10% of revenue; a fourth beginning material contributions via AEC active cable deployments in AI data centers.

CRDO.content: Credo Technology announced $750M acquisition of DustPhotonics (cash + stock + performance incentives). ALAB.title: Astera Labs Q1 2026: Revenue $308.4M (+93% YoY); Q2 Guided $355-365M — Far Above $310M Street Consensus
ALAB.content: Astera Labs Q1 2026: revenue $308.4M (+93% YoY), non-GAAP GM 76.4%, EPS $0.61. Q2 guided $355-365M vs $310.3M consensus. Scorpio X-Series (320-lane AI fabric switch) initial volume shipments commenced; PCIe Gen 6 now >1/3 of revenue.

ALAB.content: Astera Labs announced participation in three major investor conferences: JPMorgan 2026 Global TMT Conference (May 19, Boston), TD Cowen 54th Annual TMT Conference (May 27, New York), and Evercore Global TMT Conference (June 3, San Francisco). ALAB.content: Astera Labs presenting at JP Morgan 2026 Global Technology Conference today in Boston. Q1 2026 revenue $308.4M (record), Q2 guidance $355-365M (+15-18% sequential). Google+AWS guiding ~$400B combined 2026 capex benefits ALAB CXL/PCIe products.

ALAB.content: Astera Labs reported record Q1 2026 revenue $308.4M (+65% YoY), driven by AI solutions. CIEN.content: Ciena Q1 FY2026: record revenue $1.43B (+33% YoY), adj EPS $1.35 beat $1.05 estimate by 28.6%, adj GM 44.7%. CIEN.title: Ciena Stock +119% YTD as AI Optical Networking Demand Accelerates; Q2 FY2026 Earnings Scheduled June 4
CIEN.content: Ciena shares have surged 119% year-to-date driven by broad-based AI optical networking demand. TT.title: Trane Technologies Presents at Bank of America Industrials Conference; Morgan Stanley Raises PT to $565 on Data Center HVAC Demand
TT.content: Trane Technologies management presented at the Bank of America Industrials, Transportation & Airlines Key Leaders Conference (May 13). Morgan Stanley raised PT to $565 from $535. Multiple firms lifted targets May 1-4 (Evercore, Mizuho, Oppenheimer, KeyBanc). Trane Technologies acquired Stellar Energy for ~$553M to deepen data center cooling capabilities. Q1 EPS $2.63 beat; raised FY26 adj EPS to $14.75-14.95.

TT.title: Trane Technologies Q1 2026: Record Bookings $6.7B +27%; Data Center Backlog $10.7B; Acquires Liquidstack
TT.content: Trane Q1 2026: Total bookings record $6.7B (+27%), backlog $10.7B (+30% vs year-end 2025). Customer lead times stretched 12-18 months. Closed Liquidstack acquisition for two-phase liquid cooling market entry.

TT.title: Trane Technologies -5.3% on Nvidia Vera Rubin Cooling Architecture Announcement; Chiller Demand Narrative Challenged
TT.content: Trane Technologies fell 5.3% on May 20 after Nvidia CEO revealed Vera Rubin GPUs use direct hot-water cooling loops that bypass traditional chilled-water HVAC systems. Raises questions about long-term demand for large data center air chillers. Sector-wide HVAC selloff. TT's Q1 2026 bookings for data center HVAC had been strong prior to this announcement.

JCI.title: Johnson Controls Q2 FY2026: Orders +30%; Record Backlog $20B; Adj EPS +45% to $1.19; Raises FY2026 Guidance
JCI.content: JCI Q2 FY2026: sales +8% to $6.1B (organic +6%), adj EPS $1.19 (+45% YoY); orders +30% with record $20B backlog driven by data center and technology demand. Raised FY2026 guidance to ~6% organic sales growth and adj EPS ~$4.85.

JCI.title: Johnson Controls AI Factory Reference Design Guide 2.0: Air-Cooled Chillers for 1GW Hyperscale Data Centers
JCI.content: Johnson Controls released its second AI Factory Reference Design Guide covering air-cooled chiller architectures for data centers up to 1GW — targeting hyperscaler AI factories. Guide specifies 220MW cluster designs: 50MW returned to AI factory (energy recovery), 32% annual energy reduction, zero-water operation (saving 12M+ gallons/day), 30% COP improvement with 27% fewer chillers. JCI Q2 FY2026 orders +30%, backlog record $20B.

JCI.title: Johnson Controls Q2 FY2026: Data Center BMS Orders Accelerate; HVAC Backlog Grows on AI Buildout
JCI.content: JCI Q2 FY2026 results continue to reflect strong data center Building Management System (BMS) and HVAC demand. Q1 FY2026 revenue $6.14B (+12% YoY), targeting data center AI thermal management as key growth vertical.

JCI.title: JCI -6.2% as Nvidia Vera Rubin "No Chillers Needed" Cooling Announcement Disrupts HVAC Thesis; Alloy Enterprises Acquisition Complete
JCI.content: Johnson Controls fell 6.2% on May 20 after Jensen Huang announced Vera Rubin data center GPUs use hot-water cooling loops without requiring conventional air-cooled chillers. JCI completed acquisition of Alloy Enterprises (advanced thermal management for data centers) on May 13. Sector-wide HVAC selloff: MOD -7.5%, JCI -6.2%, TT -5.3%.

NRG.title: NRG Energy Q1 2026: Revenue $10.26B Post-LS Power Acquisition; EPS $1.49 Misses $2.78 Estimate on Texas Weather Costs
NRG.content: NRG Q1 2026: revenue $10.26B (from $8.59B) following January close of ~$13B LS Power acquisition (13GW gas generation). EPS $1.49 missed $2.78 consensus due to mild Texas weather and Winter Storm Fern supply costs. Reaffirmed 2026 guidance; announced $1B share buyback.

NRG.title: NRG Energy Signs Long-Term 295MW Power Deal for Two Texas AI Data Centers on Company-Owned Sites
NRG.content: NRG signed a long-term 295MW power supply agreement serving two data centers on company-owned Texas sites, part of its strategy to monetize the expanded post-LS Power generation fleet for AI data center demand growth.

NRG.title: NRG Energy Falls 8.8% After Q1 EPS Miss Despite Revenue Beat; LS Power Integration Adds Temporary Cost Pressure
NRG.content: NRG Energy stock fell 8.8% after Q1 2026 EPS of $1.49 missed $2.78 consensus, impacted by mild Texas weather and Winter Storm Fern costs following the $13B LS Power acquisition close. Revenue $10.26B beat $8.64B estimate; FY2026 EPS guidance $7.90-9.90 reaffirmed. Strategy: contracting at least 1GW of data center power deals; Texas 1GW residential VPP by 2035.

NRG.title: NRG Energy Q1 2026: Revenue $10.26B; Data Center PPA Strategy Expands as Power Demand Surges
NRG.content: NRG Q1 2026 revenue $10.26B. Company continues expanding long-term power purchase agreements with hyperscaler data center customers. Retail electricity + gas generation portfolio benefits from AI-driven industrial power demand.

KMI.title: Kinder Morgan Q1 2026: EPS +41% to $0.48; Acquires Monument Pipeline for $505M; Moody's Upgrades to Baa1
KMI.content: KMI Q1 2026: adj EPS +41% YoY to $0.48, revenue +13.8% to $4.83B. Announced and closed $505M acquisition of Monument Pipeline (225-mile Houston-area system) on May 1. Moody's upgraded to Baa1. Long take-or-pay contracts expand Texas intrastate gas network supporting data center generation.

KMI.title: Kinder Morgan Greenlights $7B in New Natural Gas Pipeline Projects for Data Center Power and LNG Export Demand
KMI.content: Kinder Morgan approved $7B in new pipeline projects: MSX (Mississippi Crossing), SSE4 (South System Expansion 4), and Trident Intrastate Pipeline ($1.8B, 219 miles, 2 Bcf/d from Katy to Port Arthur, TX). Projects add ~3.4+ Bcf/d capacity targeting data center power generation growth and LNG export terminals. Total project backlog $9.3B; dividend raised to $1.19/share (9th consecutive annual increase).

KMI.title: Kinder Morgan COO Art Holland Retiring Sept 4; Kenneth Grubb Named Successor
KMI.content: Kinder Morgan announced Chief Operating Officer Art Holland plans to retire effective September 4, 2026. Kenneth W. Grubb appointed as new COO. Company also scheduled Bernstein Strategic Decisions Conference presentation for May 27.

WMB.title: Williams Companies Q1 2026: Record Adj EBITDA $2.25B (+13% YoY); Raises Growth CapEx to $7.3B; Dividend +5%
WMB.content: Williams Q1 2026: record adj EBITDA $2.25B (+13% YoY), adj EPS $0.73 beat $0.65 consensus. Deepwater Gulf EBITDA +60%+, Natural Gas Storage +35%. Raised growth CapEx midpoint to $7.3B; increased annualized dividend 5% to $2.10/share. Reaffirmed 2026 EBITDA guidance $8.05-8.35B.

WMB.title: Williams Companies Natural Gas Infrastructure Expansion for Data Centers; Stock +23.3% YTD as AI Power Demand Accelerates
WMB.content: Williams Companies is expanding its natural gas infrastructure specifically to meet data center power demand, with its vast U.S. pipeline network increasingly critical for AI-driven electricity generation. WMB stock is up 23.3% year-to-date and holds a $93.1B market cap (May 5). Record Q1 2026 adj EBITDA $2.25B (+13% YoY); dividend raised 5% to $2.10/share annualized. CapEx raised to $7.3B growth midpoint.

ASE.title: ASE Technology Q1 2026: Revenue +17.2% YoY to NT$173.7B (~$5.44B); ATM Segment +29.7%; Net Income Nearly Doubles
ASE.content: ASE Technology Q1 2026: net revenues +17.2% YoY to NT$173.7B (~$5.44B USD). ATM (assembly, testing, materials) +29.7% YoY; net income nearly doubled to NT$14.1B. Gross margin +3.3 pp YoY to 20.1%. Advanced packaging (CoWoS/SoIC) demand driving growth. ADR shares rose ~3.4% premarket.

ASE.title: ASE Technology Advanced Packaging Sales to Double to $3.2B in 2026; Leading CoWoP Development for NVIDIA Next-Gen Architecture
ASE.content: ASE Technology projects advanced packaging sales to double to $3.2B in 2026 as TSMC outsources CoWoS capacity overflow amid AI chip demand. ASE CoWoS wafer capacity projected at 20,000-25,000/month by year-end (3x current). ASE/SPIL leading development of CoWoP (Chip-on-Wafer-on-PCB) — NVIDIA's next packaging architecture that eliminates the substrate — in coordination with leading PCB manufacturers.

ASE.title: ASE Technology April 2026 Monthly Revenue +23.1% YoY to NT$61.7B; LEAP Advanced Packaging Services Guide Raised to $3.5B+
ASE.content: ASE Technology reported April 2026 monthly net revenues of approximately NT$61.7B (US$1.96B), up 23.1% year-over-year, maintaining strong momentum following Q1 2026 (+17.2% YoY). Separately, ASE revised its LEAP (advanced packaging services) revenue guidance upward to over $3.5B for 2026, a 10% increase from prior estimates, driven by CoWoS capacity overflow from TSMC and AI chip demand.

ASE.title: ASE Technology Q1 2026: Revenue NT$112.4B +29.7% YoY; AI CoWoS Advanced Packaging Demand Drives Growth
ASE.content: ASE Q1 2026: Net revenues NT$112.4B (+29.7% YoY, +2.5% QoQ), net income NT$14.1B, EPS NT$3.24/ADS $0.205. CoWoS and advanced packaging capacity expansions driven by NVDA Blackwell and AI chip demand from hyperscalers.

AMKR.title: Amkor Technology Q1 2026: Record Revenue $1.685B (+27% YoY); EPS $0.33 Beats by 50%; Q2 Guided $1.75-1.85B
AMKR.content: Amkor Q1 2026: record net sales $1.685B (+27% YoY), EPS $0.33 beat $0.22 consensus by 50% on broad-based demand and advanced packaging (2.5D/3D) strength. Q2 guided $1.75-1.85B with EPS $0.42-0.52. Full-year capex $2.5-3.0B for capacity expansion. Stock fell ~9% AH despite the beat.

AMKR.title: Amkor and TSMC Expand Arizona Advanced Packaging Partnership; Amkor to Build Largest U.S. Packaging Facility ($7B Investment)
AMKR.content: Amkor Technology and TSMC expanded their partnership to collaborate on advanced packaging in Arizona, directly supporting TSMC's Arizona semiconductor fabs. Amkor is investing $7B to build the largest advanced packaging facility in the United States — producing 2.5D and 3D package configurations for AI chips including NVIDIA Blackwell and next-generation architectures. Facility expected to begin production in 2027.

AMKR.title: Amkor Prices $1.0B in 0% Convertible Notes Due 2031; Stock Jumps 6% on Capital Market Confidence
AMKR.content: Amkor Technology priced $1.0B of 0% coupon convertible senior notes due July 2031 (with $150M overallotment option for up to $1.15B total). Net proceeds ~$981.7M earmarked for AI advanced packaging capacity expansion. AMKR stock jumped 6% on successful execution, signaling investor confidence ahead of May 21 investor day. Follows record Q1 2026 revenue $1.685B (+27% YoY) and $7B Arizona facility partnership with TSMC.

AMKR.title: Amkor Technology May 21 Investor Day: CEO Engel to Outline Advanced Packaging Roadmap and Multi-Year Targets
AMKR.content: Amkor Technology investor day May 21, 2026 in New York: CEO Kevin Engel and CFO Megan Faust to present strategic priorities and multi-year financial targets. Company entering day with record Q1 2026 revenue $1.685B (+27% YoY), Q2 guided $1.75-1.85B, $7B Arizona advanced packaging facility with TSMC, and $1.0B convertible notes priced. AI chip 2.5D/3D advanced packaging capacity ramp for NVIDIA next-gen architectures expected to be key focus.

AMKR.title: Amkor Technology Expands Advanced Packaging for AI; Q1 2026 Revenue $1.69B; AMKR 2.5D Packaging Ramp
AMKR.content: AMKR Q1 2026: Revenue $1.69B (+5% YoY), advanced packaging (2.5D/3D) for AI chips growing. Company expanding capacity for AI accelerator packaging alongside ASE. Market cap ~$80B.

TER.title: Teradyne Q1 2026: Record Revenue $1.282B (+87% YoY); ~70% AI-Related Demand (HBM/SoC Test); Q2 Guided $1.15-1.25B
TER.content: Teradyne Q1 2026: record revenue $1.282B surging 87% YoY with ~70% of revenues tied to AI-related demand for HBM and SoC test equipment. Non-GAAP EPS $2.56 beat $2.12 estimate by $0.44. Q2 guided $1.15-1.25B revenue and non-GAAP EPS $1.86-2.15.

TER.title: Teradyne Falls 19% After Record Q1 2026 Despite 87% Revenue Growth; AI-Driven Demand Accounts for 70% of Revenue
TER.content: Teradyne stock fell 19%+ despite reporting record Q1 2026 revenue $1.282B (beat estimates +7.5%) and EPS $2.56 (+23% surprise). AI-related demand (HBM and SoC test equipment) represented ~70% of Q1 revenue. Q2 guided $1.15-1.25B — below Q1 levels — sparking concerns about demand normalization after AI-driven pull-forward. Investors debating whether the selloff created a buying opportunity.

TER.title: Teradyne Q1 2026 Record: Revenue $1.28B +87% YoY; HBM/AI Drives 70% of Revenue; Stock -12% on Sustainability Fears
TER.content: TER Q1 2026: Revenue $1.28B (+87% YoY, record), Semiconductor Test >$1B first time, GM 60.9%, EPS $2.56 vs $2.18 est. AI/HBM testing = 70% of revenue. Q2 guidance $1.15-1.25B. Stock initially fell 12% after-hours on high-valuation sustainability concerns.

NOW.title: ServiceNow Q1 2026: Revenue +22%; Now Assist ACV Target Raised to $1.5B; Stock Falls 14-17% on Iran War Deal Delay Disclosure
NOW.content: ServiceNow Q1 2026: subscription revenue $3.67B (+22% YoY); raised FY2026 subscription revenue guidance by $205M to $15.735-15.775B; Now Assist ACV target raised $1B to $1.5B. Stock fell 14-17% on disclosure of ~75bps headwind from delayed large on-premise deals in the Middle East due to the Iran war.

NOW.title: ServiceNow Knowledge 2026: Otto AI, Action Fabric, Project Arc (with NVIDIA); $30B Revenue Target by 2030 Set
NOW.content: ServiceNow unveiled at Knowledge 2026 (Las Vegas): Otto enterprise AI experience executing entire business processes; Action Fabric enabling governed actions from external AI systems; Project Arc (with NVIDIA) — autonomous desktop AI agent in early preview; Autonomous Workforce suite completing workflows without human intervention. Set long-term $30B annual subscription revenue target by 2030 (20% CAGR). Now Assist ACV $750M in Q1, targeting $1.5B by year-end.

NOW.title: ServiceNow Q1 2026: cRPO $12.64B +22.5% YoY; 16 Deals >$5M Net New ACV, +80% YoY
NOW.content: NOW Q1 2026 exceeded high end of guidance: cRPO $12.64B (+22.5% YoY). 16 transactions over $5M in net new ACV, +80% YoY. Now Assist (AI workflow) gaining enterprise traction. Upcoming: Q2 FY2026 earnings call.

NOW.title: ServiceNow Launches Autonomous CRM Competing Directly with Salesforce; BofA Reiterates Buy Rating
NOW.content: ServiceNow expanded into autonomous CRM with new customer experience features unveiled at Knowledge 2026 (May 5-7), directly targeting Salesforce's market. Stock jumped ~9% on the AI platform expansion. BofA reiterates Buy on NOW while cautious on CRM. ServiceNow Q1 FY2026 strong. Enterprise AI workflow automation TAM expansion from IT service management into CRM and sales.

CRM.title: Salesforce FY2026 Results: $41.5B Revenue (+10%); Agentforce $800M ARR (+169%); FY2027 Revenue Guided $45.8-46.2B
CRM.content: Salesforce FY2026: revenue $41.5B (+10% YoY), RPO $72B (+14%). Agentforce ARR reached $800M (+169% YoY) with 29,000 deals closed (+50% QoQ). Combined Agentforce + Data 360 ARR $2.9B (+200%+ YoY). FY2027 revenue guided $45.8-46.2B (+10-11%). Q1 FY2027 earnings scheduled May 27, 2026. Next earnings date approaching.

CRM.title: Fortune: Salesforce Agentforce Converts 20 Trillion Tokens Into 2.4B Agentic Work Units — AI Turns Efficiency Into Revenue
CRM.content: Salesforce reports Agentforce has processed ~20 trillion tokens converting them into 2.4 billion agentic work units — measurable AI-to-business-output productivity gains. CEO Benioff positions Salesforce as leading AI-for-enterprise platform competing directly with Microsoft Copilot. Agentforce vs. Copilot competition intensifying as both target large enterprise AI deployment at scale; Salesforce differentiated by CRM data integration depth.

CRM.title: Salesforce Secures $72M U.S. Air Force Enterprise License Agreement; Q1 FY2027 Earnings on May 27
CRM.content: Salesforce secured a $72M enterprise license agreement with the U.S. Air Force, expanding government AI deployment. Q1 FY2027 results scheduled May 27 after market close. Agentforce ARR grew 330% YoY. Company executing $25B accelerated share repurchase — its largest buyback ever. CRM stock down 30% in 2026 as Citigroup cut PT to $188 (Neutral) on SaaS transition concerns.

CRM.title: Citigroup Cuts Salesforce Target to $188 Ahead of Q1 Earnings; Stock Down 30% YTD on SaaS Transition Concerns
CRM.content: Citigroup lowered its Salesforce price target to $188 (from $200) maintaining Neutral rating, citing concerns over SaaS-to-AI platform transition timing and competitive pressure from Microsoft Copilot. CRM down 30% YTD and 36% over past 12 months despite Agentforce ARR growing 330% YoY. $25B buyback program largest in company history; FY2027 earnings guide $45.8-46.2B. Q1 FY2027 results May 27.

CRM.title: Bank of America Downgrades Salesforce to Underperform with $160 Target Amid AI Monetization Concerns
CRM.content: BofA downgraded CRM to Underperform, $160 target, citing AI monetization concerns and customer growth questions. Salesforce Q1 FY2026: Revenue $9.8B (+8% YoY), guidance raised. Q2 FY2026 earnings due May 27.

CRM.title: Salesforce Q1 FY2027 Earnings May 27: Consensus EPS $3.12 (+20.9% YoY); BofA Cautious Amid ServiceNow CRM Competition
CRM.content: Salesforce reports Q1 FY2027 on May 27. Consensus: EPS $3.12 (+20.9% YoY). BofA reinstated coverage cautiously citing ServiceNow's autonomous CRM expansion as competitive threat. Key metric: Agentforce AI agent adoption and seat expansion. Stock at ~$175. Q2 FY2027 guide will be closely watched for AI monetization signals.
